In an investigation spanning from Georgia to South America, local police, the DEA, U.S. Customs and the FBI work together to take down this dangerous drug gang.

programme.title: Los archivos del FBI (Doblado)
programme.desc: El primero de octubre de 1993, un extraño secuestró a Polly Klaas de doce años durante una piyamada en su casa. El FBI de inmediato entró en el caso. Los agentes reunieron fibras de su habitación y descubrieron, a través del uso de fuentes de luz láser, la huella de una palma en la cama de Polly, previamente invisible al ojo humano. Después de una extensa investigación de dos meses, el FBI arrestó a Richard Allen Davis. La impresión de la palma y las fibras coincidieron y Davis fue condenado por secuestro y asesinato.

programme.title: The FBI Files
programme.desc: California Highway Patrolman George Gwaltney discovered the body of 23-year-old Robin Bishop near her car on a remote desert highway. Although he proclaimed his innocence the FBI lab experts were able to link tool marks found on the frame with tools found in Gwaltney's home. Through the match of hairs and fibers and a unique test for detecting and identifying sperm, Gwaltney was placed at the scene of the crime.

programme.title: Los archivos del FBI (Doblado)
programme.desc: El 21 de junio de 1964, tres defensores de los derechos civiles, uno blanco y uno negro, desaparecieron de Mississippi mientras cruzaban el condado de Neshoba. Una investigación del FBI a gran escala llevó a la recuperación de los cuerpos de los hombres asesinados y la evidencia física fue recuperada y analizada. Los laboratorios del FBI confirmaron que todas excepto una de las balas usadas para asesinar a los hombres provenían de la misma arma. El FBI se ganó la confianza de un informante, cuya información condujo a la condena de siete miembros del Ku Klux Klan local.

programme.title: The FBI Files
programme.desc: Two couples found themselves on the same deserted island paradise. But only one couple left alive. Buck Walker and Stephanie Stearns arrived in Hawaii on the Sea Wind, which belonged to the missing couple, Mac and Muff Graham. Buck and Stephanie were arrested and served time for boat theft. But years later, bones were discovered on the deserted island and identified as the remains of Muff Graham.

programme.title: The FBI Files
programme.desc: On June 21, 1964, three civil rights workers, two white and one black disappeared in Mississippi while passing through Neshoba County. A massive FBI investigation led to the recovery of the bodies of the slain men and physical evidence was recovered and analyzed. The FBI labs confirmed that all but one of the bullets used to kill the men came from the same gun. The FBI gained the trust of an informant, whose information led to the conviction of seven local Ku Klux Klan members.

programme.title: The FBI Files
programme.desc: He wandered the streets of New York City wearing only pajamas and a bathrobe, but the FBI was convinced that Vince Gigante, the reputed boss of the Genovese crime family, was anything but crazy. The FBI used undercover surveillance, secret audio tapes, six mobsters turned government informants and the testimony of twelve FBI agents to help convict Gigante of murder and conspiracy-to-murder, including a plot to kill rival mob boss John Gotti.

programme.title: The FBI Files
programme.desc: The rapes and murders of ten women near Tampa, Florida in 1984 had the authorities puzzled and the community scared. Since the beginning, the FBI had been analyzing the crime scene evidence and had found a common link: red trilobal carpet fibers. But there was no suspect, until one of the killer's potential victims survived. Through her interviews and the cooperation of local authorities and the FBI, 31-year-old Bobby Joe Long emerged as the prime suspect.

programme.title: The FBI Files
programme.desc: Claude Dallas lived the life of a cowboy. A loner and distrustful of authority, he lived off the land, poaching wildlife and selling the hides. But when two game wardens confronted Dallas about his deeds, they were shot and killed. After a massive manhunt, Dallas was captured and convicted, only to escape months later. Making the FBI's Ten Most Wanted list, Dallas eluded the law for almost a year until the FBI tracked him down in a small town in California.

programme.title: The FBI Files
programme.desc: He was a recluse who spread terror through the mail for 18 years. Two men died and more than a dozen were injured, but Ted Kaczynski wasn't known as the Unabomber until his brother tipped off the FBI. Kaczynski's “Unabomber Manifesto,” published in major newspapers, set off a flurry of activity for the FBI: writing analysis and comparisons, DNA gleaned from a single postage stamp and finally, Kaczynski's arrest at his tiny cabin.

programme.title: The FBI Files
programme.desc: When five-year-old Melissa Brannen disappeared from a Christmas party in December 1989, the only probable suspect was 24-year-old Caleb Hughes. Hughes reportedly left the party around the time Melissa vanished, but no one saw him with the girl. Fifty blue acrylic fibers collected during a search of Hughes' car, however, became the major piece of evidence in the case. FBI fiber analysis determined that those fibers were identical to the ones that made up the sweater Melissa was wearing.

programme.title: The FBI Files
programme.desc: By December 1985, John Gotti had assumed his place as the new Don of the Gambino crime family in New York with the assassination of his boss, Paul Castellano. The Teflon Don felt secure in his position, always remaining one step ahead of the law. But he was also the ongoing obsession of Bruce Mouw, leader of an elite crew of FBI agents formed to bring down the Gambino family. With the help and genius of his Special Projects Squad, bugs were planted in Gotti's most private meeting places.

programme.title: The FBI Files
programme.desc: In 1984, south Miami became the home for a sadistic serial killer. Posing as a fashion photographer, Christopher Wilder lured young women from shopping malls with promises of fame and fortune. Most ended up dead. As the FBI closed in around him, Wilder took off on a cross-country murderous rampage. The FBI added Wilder to their Most Wanted Fugitives program. The chase was on, and Wilder ultimately lost.

programme.title: The FBI Files
programme.desc: Larry Horn nearly got away with the perfect crime: a multiple murder-for-hire plot that was meticulously planned and executed. Horn's former wife, their 8-year-old son, and a live-in nurse were all brutally murdered by an assassin. In the absence of any significant clues, police in Maryland contacted the FBI to assist in the investigation.

programme.title: The FBI Files
programme.desc: A cunning predator was loose in rural South Carolinaabducting young women from their own front yards in broad daylight. He was also a sadist, calling one victim's family, taunting them, boosting and then dashing their hopes. Local investigators called on the FBI to help them find this clever serial killer. Like a game of chess, FBI profilers and forensic examiners were able to outwit the killer, and put an end to his deadly game of cat and mouse.

programme.title: The FBI Files
programme.desc: When a young boy and his mother were kidnapped and murdered by a vicious drug cartel, FBI agents in the field worked tirelessly to pierce the secretive drug underworld and unearth those involved. Their surveillance and investigative work uncovered a violent trail of murder and greed. FBI agents and forensic examiners pieced together the evidence needed to draw out and then crush the cartel.

programme.title: The FBI Files
programme.desc: Local law enforcement became stumped when the body of an unidentified young woman turned up on a highway in their small Pennsylvania town. They turned to the FBI labs. The hi-tech lab enabled investigators and agents to identify the victim. Knowing who she was allowed agents to reconstruct her every move. Though the road to finding her killer was twisted and long, agents persisted.

programme.title: The FBI Files
programme.desc: A serial killer's rampage was discovered when the bodies of several young women began turning up in shallow graves that dotted the Alaskan wilderness. The killer taunted his victims, hunting them like animals before shooting them down. He was at home in the rugged terrain. But the hunt for him began 3000 miles away, where FBI profilers mapped the criminal's mind.

programme.title: The FBI Files
programme.desc: On Mississippi's Gulf Coast, a judge and his politician wife were brutally murdered in their home. The killer left few clues and the investigation led nowhere. But the FBI was patiently waiting in the wings. Once it was determined that federal laws had been violated, they pounced on the investigation. They uncovered a corrupt local government and a group of violent criminal conspirators known as the Dixie Mafia, responsible for fraud, money laundering and murder.

programme.title: The FBI Files
programme.desc: Residents of the small town of Noel, Missouri were shocked when one of their banks was robbed. When the bank president was nowhere to be found, the residents were outraged. The FBI discovered that things are not always as they appear. Minute clues led the agents to the body of the bank president. With no suspects, the FBI relied on dogged determination and modern forensics. Agents slowly pieced together tiny shreds of evidence.

programme.title: The FBI Files
programme.desc: From May until July of 1984, Alton Coleman and his common law wife, Denise Brown, engaged in a gruesome crime spree that spanned six states and left eight people dead including children. The FBI coordinated law enforcement efforts throughout the entire country in order to track the couple. Their expertise in conducting manhunts for the nation's most horrible killers paid off. The couple was located and apprehended as they prepared to kill again.

programme.title: The FBI Files
programme.desc: A young mother and her infant son mysteriously disappeared from their home. The woman's husband was the only suspect, but he was eventually cleared. There was no solid evidence that a crime had even been committed. Six months later, a local farmer found the remains of the missing woman and her child. Both had been murdered. Agents and local police had only one tiny piece of evidence, an unidentified hair found in the murdered woman's car. The hair was too small for analysis.

programme.title: The FBI Files
programme.desc: In 1980, the FBI began a massive undercover operation, code named Safebet, that was designed to expose the Chicago Mafia's infiltration into the city's surrounding suburbs. Undercover agents quickly discovered that the mob had its tentacles spread into every facet of the law enforcement community. They unwittingly uncovered the murder of a wealthy socialite perpetrated by a jealous and greedy mob lawyer and covered up by the local police chief.

programme.title: The FBI Files
programme.desc: After a series of brutal bank robberies and murders in south Miami during the mid-1980's, the FBI embarked on an exhaustive eight-month investigation. With little evidence and no suspects, agents were willing to try anything to find the violent perpetrators. On April 11, 1986, agents conducting routine surveillance spotted the vehicle used in the bank robberies. They attempted to arrest the two suspects in the car. What followed was the bloodiest firefight in FBI history.

programme.title: The FBI Files
programme.desc: Beginning in summer of 1990, the bodies of several women began turning up in and around the city of Vienna, Austria. From an extensive investigation by the Viennese police, it was determined that these murders were the work of one sadistic predator. Europe was dealing with a serial killer. With no experience with this kind of predator, Viennese police turned to the FBI. FBI profilers were able to identify a suspect in the murders. More ominously, they linked this same killer to murders committed in the United States.

programme.title: The FBI Files
programme.desc: On August 20, 1980, an unseen sniper murdered two young black men as they jogged with two white women in Salt Lake City, Utah. Police threw all their resources into finding a killer who left almost no clues behind. They met with FBI agents and detectives from around the country who had similar racially motivated sniper slayings. A month later, working off little more than a possible license plate number, police in Kentucky arrested Joseph Paul Franklin but the man escaped from custody.

programme.title: The FBI Files
programme.desc: By April of 1995 in Washington, D.C., two officers had been shot and one had been murdered. Each had been sitting in their patrol cars when a man sneaked up and opened fire. The FBI was brought in to help catch the cop killer. Agents identified the man who was most likely the killer, but he was nowhere to be found. Months of surveillance operations around the country finally yielded a break; they found their suspect in Baltimore, MD.

programme.title: The FBI Files
programme.desc: On February 3, 1990, a 14-year-old girl ran away from her mother's home and disappeared without a trace. Her mother hoped Pasadena, Texas police could find her before it was too late. Six months later, their worst fear was realized when a farmer discovered the young girl's remains in an Illinois barn. The FBI was called in to help. Agents tracked down a trucker who they believed was responsible for 50 more deaths. Investigators knew they had to stop this menace of the highways.

programme.title: The FBI Files
programme.desc: When a Delaware woman vanished in 1996, family and friends discovered her secret life. The appointments secretary to the Governor had carried on an illicit affair with a wealthy married man. Agents suspected that her powerful ex-lover was responsible, but they had little physical evidence to support their theory. Investigators never found the woman's body or the murder weapon. The FBI's only hope was to go undercover, and turn brother against brother.

programme.title: The FBI Files
programme.desc: In the early 90s, Washington, D.C. police were losing the battle against street gangs who enforced their territories with lethal violence. The homicide rate in the nation's capital climbed to the highest in the country. Local police turned to the FBI for help, but agents soon found themselves in the direct line of fire. In the fall of 1994, a gang member walked into police headquarters, killed two FBI agents and one detective, then turned the gun on himself.

programme.title: The FBI Files
programme.desc: In June of 1992, masked bandits pulled off a daring mid-day bank robbery. It marked the beginning of a four-year crime wave that rocked Seattle. With each new robbery, the bandits perfected their craft, leaving behind no evidence and escaping with hundreds and thousands of dollars. As the robbers became increasingly violent, pressure mounted to end their reign. With few leads, the FBI forced their own luck. The effort put them face to face with an armed and desperate fugitive.

programme.title: The FBI Files
programme.desc: In 1999, Police investigate two brutal murders in two small towns located hundreds of miles apart. The crimes seem random and unrelated, until investigators discover a terrifying link. Local police and the FBI must untangle a web of liesto stop a dangerous gang that will kill a man for his Identity.

programme.title: The FBI Files
programme.desc: In 1987, Seven inmates break out of a high security prison in New Mexico. The escapees, all violent criminals, are a threat to anyone who crosses their path. State and local police and the FBI know they must capture these men before they rob, rape and kill…again.

programme.title: The FBI Files
programme.desc: In Boston, FBI agents and local police tracked a gang of robbers who specialized in armored car takedowns. Their MO was familiar -- the gang used precise timing to steal millions in cash and burned their getaway cars to destroy evidence. As the robberies grew more violent, agents launched a complex sting: To trap a deadly ring of thieves and shut down their dangerous operation.

programme.title: The FBI Files
programme.desc: In the winter of 2001, two well-loved and respected college professors are found murdered in their home. Nothing about the case makes sense. No items are missing from the home and the couple had no known enemies. Local police and FBI agents form a task force to find a pair of homegrown killers and a motive for the brutal crime they committed.

programme.title: The FBI Files
programme.desc: In Georgia, a series of bizarre shootings terrorizes the town of East Point. Two people are killed, and two are critically wounded. At first the shootings seem targeted, then they seem random. As the body count climbs, the killer taunts law enforcement with mysterious notes. Agents believe the shooter will continue until he is deador behind bars.

programme.title: The FBI Files
programme.desc: In the early 90s, a gang based in the U.S. Virgin Islands began smuggling thousands of kilos of cocaine into mainland America. Police and federal agents target the gang, but its leader remains a mystery. In an investigation spanning from Georgia to South America, local police, the DEA, U.S. Customs and the FBI work together to take down this dangerous drug gang.

programme.title: Los archivos del FBI (Doblado)
programme.desc: El primero de octubre de 1993, un extraño secuestró a Polly Klaas de doce años durante una piyamada en su casa. El FBI de inmediato entró en el caso. Los agentes reunieron fibras de su habitación y descubrieron, a través del uso de fuentes de luz láser, la huella de una palma en la cama de Polly, previamente invisible al ojo humano. Después de una extensa investigación de dos meses, el FBI arrestó a Richard Allen Davis. La impresión de la palma y las fibras coincidieron y Davis fue condenado por secuestro y asesinato.

programme.title: The FBI Files
programme.desc: California Highway Patrolman George Gwaltney discovered the body of 23-year-old Robin Bishop near her car on a remote desert highway. Although he proclaimed his innocence the FBI lab experts were able to link tool marks found on the frame with tools found in Gwaltney's home. Through the match of hairs and fibers and a unique test for detecting and identifying sperm, Gwaltney was placed at the scene of the crime.

programme.title: Los archivos del FBI (Doblado)
programme.desc: El 21 de junio de 1964, tres defensores de los derechos civiles, uno blanco y uno negro, desaparecieron de Mississippi mientras cruzaban el condado de Neshoba. Una investigación del FBI a gran escala llevó a la recuperación de los cuerpos de los hombres asesinados y la evidencia física fue recuperada y analizada. Los laboratorios del FBI confirmaron que todas excepto una de las balas usadas para asesinar a los hombres provenían de la misma arma. El FBI se ganó la confianza de un informante, cuya información condujo a la condena de siete miembros del Ku Klux Klan local.

programme.title: The FBI Files
programme.desc: Two couples found themselves on the same deserted island paradise. But only one couple left alive. Buck Walker and Stephanie Stearns arrived in Hawaii on the Sea Wind, which belonged to the missing couple, Mac and Muff Graham. Buck and Stephanie were arrested and served time for boat theft. But years later, bones were discovered on the deserted island and identified as the remains of Muff Graham.

programme.title: The FBI Files
programme.desc: On June 21, 1964, three civil rights workers, two white and one black disappeared in Mississippi while passing through Neshoba County. A massive FBI investigation led to the recovery of the bodies of the slain men and physical evidence was recovered and analyzed. The FBI labs confirmed that all but one of the bullets used to kill the men came from the same gun. The FBI gained the trust of an informant, whose information led to the conviction of seven local Ku Klux Klan members.

programme.title: The FBI Files
programme.desc: He wandered the streets of New York City wearing only pajamas and a bathrobe, but the FBI was convinced that Vince Gigante, the reputed boss of the Genovese crime family, was anything but crazy. The FBI used undercover surveillance, secret audio tapes, six mobsters turned government informants and the testimony of twelve FBI agents to help convict Gigante of murder and conspiracy-to-murder, including a plot to kill rival mob boss John Gotti.

programme.title: The FBI Files
programme.desc: The rapes and murders of ten women near Tampa, Florida in 1984 had the authorities puzzled and the community scared. Since the beginning, the FBI had been analyzing the crime scene evidence and had found a common link: red trilobal carpet fibers. But there was no suspect, until one of the killer's potential victims survived. Through her interviews and the cooperation of local authorities and the FBI, 31-year-old Bobby Joe Long emerged as the prime suspect.

programme.title: The FBI Files
programme.desc: Claude Dallas lived the life of a cowboy. A loner and distrustful of authority, he lived off the land, poaching wildlife and selling the hides. But when two game wardens confronted Dallas about his deeds, they were shot and killed. After a massive manhunt, Dallas was captured and convicted, only to escape months later. Making the FBI's Ten Most Wanted list, Dallas eluded the law for almost a year until the FBI tracked him down in a small town in California.

programme.title: The FBI Files
programme.desc: He was a recluse who spread terror through the mail for 18 years. Two men died and more than a dozen were injured, but Ted Kaczynski wasn't known as the Unabomber until his brother tipped off the FBI. Kaczynski's “Unabomber Manifesto,” published in major newspapers, set off a flurry of activity for the FBI: writing analysis and comparisons, DNA gleaned from a single postage stamp and finally, Kaczynski's arrest at his tiny cabin.

programme.title: The FBI Files
programme.desc: When five-year-old Melissa Brannen disappeared from a Christmas party in December 1989, the only probable suspect was 24-year-old Caleb Hughes. Hughes reportedly left the party around the time Melissa vanished, but no one saw him with the girl. Fifty blue acrylic fibers collected during a search of Hughes' car, however, became the major piece of evidence in the case. FBI fiber analysis determined that those fibers were identical to the ones that made up the sweater Melissa was wearing.

programme.title: The FBI Files
programme.desc: By December 1985, John Gotti had assumed his place as the new Don of the Gambino crime family in New York with the assassination of his boss, Paul Castellano. The Teflon Don felt secure in his position, always remaining one step ahead of the law. But he was also the ongoing obsession of Bruce Mouw, leader of an elite crew of FBI agents formed to bring down the Gambino family. With the help and genius of his Special Projects Squad, bugs were planted in Gotti's most private meeting places.

programme.title: The FBI Files
programme.desc: In 1984, south Miami became the home for a sadistic serial killer. Posing as a fashion photographer, Christopher Wilder lured young women from shopping malls with promises of fame and fortune. Most ended up dead. As the FBI closed in around him, Wilder took off on a cross-country murderous rampage. The FBI added Wilder to their Most Wanted Fugitives program. The chase was on, and Wilder ultimately lost.

programme.title: The FBI Files
programme.desc: Larry Horn nearly got away with the perfect crime: a multiple murder-for-hire plot that was meticulously planned and executed. Horn's former wife, their 8-year-old son, and a live-in nurse were all brutally murdered by an assassin. In the absence of any significant clues, police in Maryland contacted the FBI to assist in the investigation.

programme.title: The FBI Files
programme.desc: A cunning predator was loose in rural South Carolinaabducting young women from their own front yards in broad daylight. He was also a sadist, calling one victim's family, taunting them, boosting and then dashing their hopes. Local investigators called on the FBI to help them find this clever serial killer. Like a game of chess, FBI profilers and forensic examiners were able to outwit the killer, and put an end to his deadly game of cat and mouse.

programme.title: The FBI Files
programme.desc: When a young boy and his mother were kidnapped and murdered by a vicious drug cartel, FBI agents in the field worked tirelessly to pierce the secretive drug underworld and unearth those involved. Their surveillance and investigative work uncovered a violent trail of murder and greed. FBI agents and forensic examiners pieced together the evidence needed to draw out and then crush the cartel.

programme.title: The FBI Files
programme.desc: Local law enforcement became stumped when the body of an unidentified young woman turned up on a highway in their small Pennsylvania town. They turned to the FBI labs. The hi-tech lab enabled investigators and agents to identify the victim. Knowing who she was allowed agents to reconstruct her every move. Though the road to finding her killer was twisted and long, agents persisted.

programme.title: The FBI Files
programme.desc: A serial killer's rampage was discovered when the bodies of several young women began turning up in shallow graves that dotted the Alaskan wilderness. The killer taunted his victims, hunting them like animals before shooting them down. He was at home in the rugged terrain. But the hunt for him began 3000 miles away, where FBI profilers mapped the criminal's mind.

programme.title: The FBI Files
programme.desc: On Mississippi's Gulf Coast, a judge and his politician wife were brutally murdered in their home. The killer left few clues and the investigation led nowhere. But the FBI was patiently waiting in the wings. Once it was determined that federal laws had been violated, they pounced on the investigation. They uncovered a corrupt local government and a group of violent criminal conspirators known as the Dixie Mafia, responsible for fraud, money laundering and murder.

programme.title: The FBI Files
programme.desc: Residents of the small town of Noel, Missouri were shocked when one of their banks was robbed. When the bank president was nowhere to be found, the residents were outraged. The FBI discovered that things are not always as they appear. Minute clues led the agents to the body of the bank president. With no suspects, the FBI relied on dogged determination and modern forensics. Agents slowly pieced together tiny shreds of evidence.

programme.title: The FBI Files
programme.desc: From May until July of 1984, Alton Coleman and his common law wife, Denise Brown, engaged in a gruesome crime spree that spanned six states and left eight people dead including children. The FBI coordinated law enforcement efforts throughout the entire country in order to track the couple. Their expertise in conducting manhunts for the nation's most horrible killers paid off. The couple was located and apprehended as they prepared to kill again.

programme.title: The FBI Files
programme.desc: A young mother and her infant son mysteriously disappeared from their home. The woman's husband was the only suspect, but he was eventually cleared. There was no solid evidence that a crime had even been committed. Six months later, a local farmer found the remains of the missing woman and her child. Both had been murdered. Agents and local police had only one tiny piece of evidence, an unidentified hair found in the murdered woman's car. The hair was too small for analysis.

programme.title: The FBI Files
programme.desc: In 1980, the FBI began a massive undercover operation, code named Safebet, that was designed to expose the Chicago Mafia's infiltration into the city's surrounding suburbs. Undercover agents quickly discovered that the mob had its tentacles spread into every facet of the law enforcement community. They unwittingly uncovered the murder of a wealthy socialite perpetrated by a jealous and greedy mob lawyer and covered up by the local police chief.

programme.title: The FBI Files
programme.desc: After a series of brutal bank robberies and murders in south Miami during the mid-1980's, the FBI embarked on an exhaustive eight-month investigation. With little evidence and no suspects, agents were willing to try anything to find the violent perpetrators. On April 11, 1986, agents conducting routine surveillance spotted the vehicle used in the bank robberies. They attempted to arrest the two suspects in the car. What followed was the bloodiest firefight in FBI history.

programme.title: The FBI Files
programme.desc: Beginning in summer of 1990, the bodies of several women began turning up in and around the city of Vienna, Austria. From an extensive investigation by the Viennese police, it was determined that these murders were the work of one sadistic predator. Europe was dealing with a serial killer. With no experience with this kind of predator, Viennese police turned to the FBI. FBI profilers were able to identify a suspect in the murders. More ominously, they linked this same killer to murders committed in the United States.

programme.title: The FBI Files
programme.desc: On August 20, 1980, an unseen sniper murdered two young black men as they jogged with two white women in Salt Lake City, Utah. Police threw all their resources into finding a killer who left almost no clues behind. They met with FBI agents and detectives from around the country who had similar racially motivated sniper slayings. A month later, working off little more than a possible license plate number, police in Kentucky arrested Joseph Paul Franklin but the man escaped from custody.

programme.title: The FBI Files
programme.desc: By April of 1995 in Washington, D.C., two officers had been shot and one had been murdered. Each had been sitting in their patrol cars when a man sneaked up and opened fire. The FBI was brought in to help catch the cop killer. Agents identified the man who was most likely the killer, but he was nowhere to be found. Months of surveillance operations around the country finally yielded a break; they found their suspect in Baltimore, MD.

programme.title: The FBI Files
programme.desc: On February 3, 1990, a 14-year-old girl ran away from her mother's home and disappeared without a trace. Her mother hoped Pasadena, Texas police could find her before it was too late. Six months later, their worst fear was realized when a farmer discovered the young girl's remains in an Illinois barn. The FBI was called in to help. Agents tracked down a trucker who they believed was responsible for 50 more deaths. Investigators knew they had to stop this menace of the highways.

programme.title: The FBI Files
programme.desc: When a Delaware woman vanished in 1996, family and friends discovered her secret life. The appointments secretary to the Governor had carried on an illicit affair with a wealthy married man. Agents suspected that her powerful ex-lover was responsible, but they had little physical evidence to support their theory. Investigators never found the woman's body or the murder weapon. The FBI's only hope was to go undercover, and turn brother against brother.

programme.title: The FBI Files
programme.desc: In the early 90s, Washington, D.C. police were losing the battle against street gangs who enforced their territories with lethal violence. The homicide rate in the nation's capital climbed to the highest in the country. Local police turned to the FBI for help, but agents soon found themselves in the direct line of fire. In the fall of 1994, a gang member walked into police headquarters, killed two FBI agents and one detective, then turned the gun on himself.

programme.title: The FBI Files
programme.desc: In June of 1992, masked bandits pulled off a daring mid-day bank robbery. It marked the beginning of a four-year crime wave that rocked Seattle. With each new robbery, the bandits perfected their craft, leaving behind no evidence and escaping with hundreds and thousands of dollars. As the robbers became increasingly violent, pressure mounted to end their reign. With few leads, the FBI forced their own luck. The effort put them face to face with an armed and desperate fugitive.

programme.title: Pokémon: Los campeones de la Liga Johto

programme.title: Pokémon: Los campeones de la Liga Johto

programme.title: Pokémon: Los campeones de la Liga Johto

programme.title: Pokémon: Los campeones de la Liga Johto

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.sub-title: Sueño trunchado Humillado y sin dinero
programme.desc: Antonio no quiere que su hija sea futbolista, porque no tendrá buen futuro, su madre pide la tutela de la joven. Los dueños de una casa confundieron a su empleado con un ladrón y lo lesionaron.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: Lorena quiere la custodia de su hijo porque su esposo, quien destila alcohol ilegalmente, ofreció un coctel durante una fiesta infantil. Alexis se cambia de género y tiene sexo con su padre.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.sub-title: Billetes en la carretera Cambio de edad
programme.desc: María y Paula causaron un alboroto ante las intimidaciones de Andrés y Sebastián, ellos las demandan. Elvis miente sobre su edad en papeles oficiales y le niegan la ayuda a su hijo autista.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.sub-title: Propiedad violada App para enfermedades sexuales
programme.desc: Laura destruyó el dron de Gino que volaba sobre su propiedad, él pide que se lo pague. Mileidy crea una aplicación para identificar enfermedades sexuales y descubre que su esposo es infiel.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: Vanesa se casa con Eduardo y comete el error de poner todo su dinero a nombre de él. También, Alejandro quiere recibir terapia de pareja con su esposa Carla para así salvar su matrimonio.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: Karla usa una aplicación de teléfono para sus compras y se hizo amiga del mensajero, su esposo la acusa de tener sexo oral con él. Un psicólogo trata a sus pacientes con un método peculiar.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.sub-title: Adicto a mi madre Fanático sin sentido
programme.desc: Ana le exige indemnización al pastor que abusaba sexualmente de su madre y lo responsabiliza por su suicidio. Víctor aloja en su casa al exmarido de su esposa, ella demanda que lo saque.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Pese a las advertencias, Diana Ahumada mata a dos hombres del Cabo y le exige a Ricardo que refuerce la seguridad de su familia. Dona Alba revela que Aurelio podría tener un medio hermano.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Armada hasta los dientes, Diana apunta al Cabo cuando llega con sus hombres y le indica dónde le dejó su última entrega. Arelys rompe en llanto y le cuenta toda la verdad a su jefa.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: La DEA exige a Ámbar que le entregue a cinco involucrados con la droga del gobierno venezolano.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.sub-title: El cabo se desquita con Diana
programme.desc: Mitón Jiménez va hasta Monclova a asustar a Diana. Amenaza a su familia. LA CIA alerta a la DEA sobre Águila Azul.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.sub-title: Van por Casillas y Águila Azul
programme.desc: Si no hacen nada para sacar del poder a Terán, Casillas amenaza con liquidar al presidente en una semana. Vinculan la muerte de un senador con Águila Azul. El Cabo y Evelina hacen el amor.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.sub-title: El Rojo se une a los Casillas
programme.desc: Corina busca al Rojo tras su excarcelación y lo lleva con los Casillas. Le ofrecen trabajar para ellos. Ismael secuestra al Mocho y a Evelina. Llega Nora Requena a extraditar a Aurelio.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.sub-title: Javi y Rutila salvan a Kashi
programme.desc: Super Javi y Rutila se la juegan por Kashi cuando Garañón la ataca. Castillo investiga la muerte de Gilberto y conoce a Diana. Preparan la bienvenida a Valdés en México.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos

programme.title: Eat Me (or Try Not To)
programme.desc: In under two centuries, favorite food brands span continents and cultures, spur innovation and technology, and forever change the food landscape.

programme.title: Eat Me (or Try Not To)
programme.desc: Food preferences are influenced by dozens of factors, including genetics, environment and habit, but the taste is also about perception; the color, texture and weight of food are as important as the flavor.

programme.title: Eat Me (or Try Not To)
programme.desc: At one point, each and every food brand had to come up with a plan to get people to try them; today, the food and drink marketing industry is worth about $900 billion and growing.

programme.title: Eat Me (or Try Not To)
programme.desc: With every single bite or sip that people take, they participate in one of the most sophisticated journeys around the world ever taken; the global food supply chain is part of an $8 trillion network that produces over 4 billion tons of food annually.

programme.title: Eat Me (or Try Not To)
programme.desc: Food brands travel around the world, stick around and change the places they visit; once the food is adopted by eager taste buds, it becomes part of local culture and tradition.

programme.title: Eat Me (or Try Not To)
programme.desc: Climate change, a global pandemic, and a booming world population mark an opportune time to be in the food business, not unlike the first wave of the industrial food revolution that gave people the first globally mass-produced, processed foods.

Hen et Athena sont invitées avec d'autres personnalités de la vie civile à participer à un voyage de trois heures dans l'espace. Mais une tempête géomagnétique va endommager les satellites et l'un d'eux vient percuter la capsule des astronautes en orbite terrestre basse….
Athena et Hen affrontent de nouveaux dangers dans l'espace tandis que, sur Terre, l'unité 118 porte secours aux victimes des chutes de débris dues à la tempête magnétique.

Alors que la station spatiale internationale est gravement endommagée par des débris, Athena et Hen doivent risquer leur vie pour réparer un bras robotique et permettre le retour de l'équipage sur Terre. programme.desc: Monty refreshes a container of overgrown herbs, plants alpines and revisits the shrub and perennial cuttings he took a few weeks ago. Arit Anderson meets a designer who is placing sustainability and the environment at the heart of her gardens.

programme.title: Rretheqark
programme.desc: ”Rretheqark” është dritarja që hapet çdo mbrëmje mbi botën në lëvizje. Në një orë, zbulojmë labirintet e gjeopolitikës, aty ku pushtetet maten, aleancat ndryshojnë dhe diplomacia shkruan historinë në heshtje. Ju çojmë në prapaskenën e ngjarjeve që përcaktojnë ekuilibrat globale e rajonale. Një udhëtim rretheqark , për të parë jo vetëm çfarë ndodh, por edhe ku po shkon bota dhe rajoni.\r\n”Rretheqark”, cdo mbrëmje në orën, 22:00. Nga Rosalba Bejdo dhe Xhevahir Qardaku.”.

programme.desc: ”Off the Record!” me Andrea Danglli ka si qëllim të sjellë në ekran misionin e gazetarisë së thelluar dhe analitike. Emisioni synon shtjellimin e një teme të caktuar që shqetëson shoqërinë nga e shkuara apo aktualiteti duke zbuluar përgjigjet e pikëpyetjeve të ngritura nga qytetarët përmes zërit të tyre, debatit apo informacionit për publikun.

programme.title: Newsroom
programme.desc: Lajmet nuk mjaftojnë. Ndjekim faktet, zbulojmë rrethanat, çfarë thonë dhe fshehin shifrat. Sjellim historinë në NEWSROOM. Çdo ditë, nga e hëna në të premte, ora 15:30 në A2 CNN.

programme.title: Temp
programme.desc: Temp është një program 30 minuta për t’u transmetuar gjatë fundjavës. Merret me çështjet më të nxehta të javës që mbeti pas, duke përzgjedhur një personazh, një person që ishte në që ndër të debateve apo vëmëndjes së kësaj jave. Ai mund të jetë një politikan, mjek, gazetar, kameraman, shkrimtar, sportist apo njeri i zakonshëm. Mjafton që të ketë qenë njeriu që ka bërë lajmin e kësaj jave në politikë, kronikë apo lajme suksesi sporti dhe kulture. Pas një biografie të shkurtër kamera e ndjek perzo.

programme.title: Çdo Kënd
programme.desc: Në një botë të vrullshme informacionesh, ndarja e të vërtetës nga të pavërtetat, gjysmë të vërtetat apo dezinformi është misioni i çdo medie serioze, i çdo gazetari. Ky është misioni i ÇDOKËND, një program që në 50 minuta, çdo të premte në orën 21:00 do të sjellë në A2CNN përmes gazetares Merita Haklaj ngjarjen kryesore të javës. Përgjigjet e çdo pikëpyetjeje vijnë përme kontrollit të fakteve, përballjes së palëve dhe analizës. Do t’i shohim ngjarjet në çdo kënd. Do t’i zbërthejmë ato për çdokën.

programme.title: Sous le soleil
programme.desc: Laure revient d'Afrique pour faire soigner Zacharie, un orphelin de 10 ans. Elle a un accident de voiture avec Jessica, qui fait une fausse couche. Jessica et Baptiste optent pour l'adoption et finissent par accueillir Zacharie. Laure annule un voyage en Afrique pour soutenir Jessica, en pleine dépression. Le yacht de Yannis Nomikos, le père de David, arrive à Saint-Tropez. Yannis apprend qu'il es

programme.title: La fête à la maison
programme.desc: Père veuf de trois petites filles, Danny Tanner fait de son mieux pour les élever et subvenir à leurs besoins. Il peut aussi compter sur le soutien de son beau-frère Jesse et son ami Joey, qui se sont installés chez eux pour aider Danny. Les choses sont sur le point de bouger à nouveau lorsque celui-ci devient présentateur de l'émission debout San Francisco et qu'il y rencontre Rebecca.

programme.title: Urgences
programme.desc: Carter a accepté de suivre une cure pour soigner son addiction aux médicaments. Abby, qui lutte elle-même contre sa dépendance à l'alcool, tente de le soutenir. L'arrivée inopinée de sa mère, qui souffre de troubles bipolaires, ne favorise pas l'équilibre de la jeune femme. Kerry, de son côté, est profondément troublée par Kim Legaspi, une belle psychiatre qui ne fait pas mystère de son homosexual

programme.title: John Doe
programme.desc: Il ne sait pas qui il est, mais il sait tout sur tout. Doté d'un étrange tatouage et d'une vision en noir et blanc, John Doe est en quête de son identité. En possession d'un savoir immense, il en profite pour apporter son aide aux autres quand il le peut.

programme.title: Cut
programme.desc: Adil, qui a échappé à la tentative de meurtre de Mathis, est désormais cloué dans un fauteuil roulant. Il tente de se reconstruire auprès d'Eva, tout en combattant son père et en tentant de se faire à l'idée du retour de Laura. Angèle, la kinésithérapeute au caractère bien trempé, chargée de la rééducation d'Adil, tente de son côté d'assumer ce défi professionnel tout en cherchant à comprendre Rub

programme.title: Les vacances de l'amour
programme.desc: Nicolas vole au secours d'une jeune inconnue qui est sur le point de se noyer. José est parti à la recherche de Bénédicte, dans une bien mauvaise passe. Grâce à Nicolas, les garçons décrochent un rendez-vous avec Gilles Barrois, le patron de l'hôtel, qui envisage de les engager pour une série de concerts. De 1996 à 2007, cette série développe les relations entre les personnages rencontrés dans "Hé

programme.desc: Après avoir décroché leur bac, Justine et ses amis entament une nouvelle vie d'étudiants en fac. Seules Annette, qui a échoué à l'examen, et les jumelles Suzy et Suzon, ont préféré abandonner l'école pour travailler à la cafétéria.

programme.title: Avrupa’da Türk Takımları
programme.desc: UEFA Liga e Evropës (anglisht: UEFA Europa League) është një kompedicion i përvitshëm futbollistik i organizuar nga UEFA që nga viti 1971 ku konkurojnë klubet evropiane. Klubet kualifikohen në këtë kompedicion bazuar në performancat e tyre në ligat dhe kupat kombëtare përkatëse. Është kompedicioni i dytë për nga rëndësia nga UEFA, duke u renditur mbrapa UEFA Ligës së Kampioneve.

programme.title: Şampiyonlar Ligi Özel
programme.desc: Liga e Kampionëve është kompeticioni kryesor vjetor i UEFA-s për klubet e futbollit, që bashkon ekipet më të mira nga ligat kombëtare të Evropës. E themeluar në vitin 1955 si Kupa e Klubeve Kampione të Evropës dhe e riemërtuar në vitin 1992, ajo ka evoluar nga një turne me eliminim të drejtpërdrejtë në një fazë lige me 36 skuadra, të pasuar nga raunde me eliminim të drejtpërdrejtë dhe një finale me një ndeshje të vetme. Kualifikimi bazohet kryesisht në paraqitjen në ligat kombëtare dhe në koeficientët e federatave anëtare të UEFA-s, ndërsa kompeticioni përfaqëson nivelin më të lartë të futbollit evropian për klube. Fituesi shpallet kampion i Evropës për klube dhe kualifikohet gjithashtu për kompeticione të tjera të rëndësishme të UEFA-s dhe FIFA-s.

programme.title: AVRUPA LİGİ ÖZEL
programme.desc: Liga e Evropës e UEFA-s është një kompeticion vjetor i futbollit për klube, i organizuar që nga viti 1971 nga UEFA për klubet evropiane të kualifikueshme. Është kompeticioni i nivelit të dytë i futbollit evropian për klube, duke u renditur poshtë Ligës së Kampionëve të UEFA-s dhe mbi Ligën e Konferencës të UEFA-s. I prezantuar në vitin 1971 si Kupa UEFA, ai zëvendësoi Kupën e Panaireve Ndërqytetëse. Kompeticioni mori emrin e tij aktual në vitin 2009, pas një ndryshimi të formatit që përfshinte një bashkim me Kupën Intertoto të UEFA-s, duke zgjeruar fazën e grupeve dhe duke ndryshuar kualifikimin. Në sezonin 2024–25, faza e grupeve u zëvendësua nga një fazë lige me 36 ekipe. Fituesit e Ligës së Evropës të UEFA-s kualifikohen për Superkupën e UEFA-s dhe Ligën e Kampionëve të UEFA-s të sezonit pasardhës.

programme.title: Avrupa’da Türk Takımları
programme.desc: UEFA Liga e Evropës (anglisht: UEFA Europa League) është një kompedicion i përvitshëm futbollistik i organizuar nga UEFA që nga viti 1971 ku konkurojnë klubet evropiane. Klubet kualifikohen në këtë kompedicion bazuar në performancat e tyre në ligat dhe kupat kombëtare përkatëse. Është kompedicioni i dytë për nga rëndësia nga UEFA, duke u renditur mbrapa UEFA Ligës së Kampioneve.

Hudson & Rex
programme.desc: Nachdem ihr Freund Nick bei einem Diebstahl in echte Schwieriegkeiten geraten ist, wendet sich Jess' Schwester Chrystal hilfesuchend an ihren Bruder. Jess fliegt daraufhin mit Sarah und Rex in den Norden, um Chrystal zu unterstützen. Doch vor Ort kommt zu einer schweren Schießerei, Crystal, Jesse, Rex und Sarah müssen in einem kleinen Flugzeug fliehen... (Senderinfo).

programme.title: Hudson & Rex
programme.desc: Charlies Tante Miranda und deren Freunde sind Burce, einem Investmentbetrüger auf den Leim gegangen und stehen kurz davor viel Geld zu verlieren. Miranda wird beim Einbruch bei dem vermeintlichen Betrüger überrascht und muss ihrem Neffen Charlie Rede und Antwort stehen. Als Bruce dann am nächsten Tag tot aufgefunden wird, deutet alles darauf hin, dass Miranda die Tat begangen hat… (Senderinfo).

programme.title: Sea Patrol
programme.desc: Die Hammersley geht dem Notruf eines Frachters nach, doch als sie dessen Position erreicht, ist das Schiff gesunken. Mit Ausnahme des Seemanns Pearson wurden alle Crewmitglieder getötet. Er berichtet, dass Osteuropäer das Schiff geentert und die Crew gezwungen hatten, ihre Ladung auf den Kabinenkreuzer der Kidnapper umzuladen. (Senderinfo).

programme.title: Sea Patrol
programme.desc: Die Crew der Hammersley leistet Aufbauhilfe auf den Samaru-Inseln, als plötzlich eine Mörsergranate einschlägt. Mike erhält Order, die Verletzen auf der Insel Tampu abzusetzen, als Jim um ein Schlauchboot für seine SAS-Einheit bittet. (Senderinfo).

programme.title: Sea Patrol
programme.desc: Interimsweise übernimmt Commander Freeman das Kommando an Bord der Hammersley, die einem Notruf nachgeht, doch der Trawler reagiert nicht auf Kates Funksprüche und versucht zu rammen. Abgesehen von Problemen mit der Steuerung scheint an Bord des Fischerboots alles in Ordnung zu sein, so dass die Entermannschaft schnell wieder abrückt. (Senderinfo).

programme.title: Sea Patrol
programme.desc: Die Hammersley empfängt einen Notruf von Walsmans Yacht Enterprise. Die Angreifer werden in die Flucht geschlagen, doch Walsman scheint vor allem die Marine von seinem Gast fern halten zu wollen. Der Grund wird schnell klar: Als die Crew der Hammersley das Schiff der Angreifer aufbringt, erkennen sie auf einem Flugblatt Walsmans Gast. (Senderinfo).

programme.title: Hudson & Rex
programme.desc: Nachdem sie mit dem Flugzeug abgestürzt sind, schafft Rex es, Detective Sidney Scott zur Absturzstelle zu führen und Jesse, Sarah und Crystal können gerettet werden. Außerdem stellt sich heraus, dass nicht Nick der Mörder seiner Hausherrin war, die bei dem Diebstahl ums Leben gekommen ist. Das Team findet die wahren Verantwortlichen und entdeckt dabei noch mehr. (Senderinfo).

programme.title: The Baker
programme.desc: Nach langer Zeit meldet sich Pappis (Ron Perlman) entfremdeter Sohn bei ihm, um dann gleich wieder zu verschwinden. Nun muss der ehemalige Killer seine Enkelin Delphi (Emma Ho) vor der Drogenmafia beschützen, mit der sich sein Sohn angelegt hat. Delphi spricht seit dem Tod ihrer Mutter nicht mehr.

programme.title: Hudson & Rex
programme.desc: Als bei einern Theaterprobe das Reality-TV Sternchen Tegan zu Tode kommt, denken alle an einen tragischen Bühnenunfall. Doch Sarah stellt fest, dass mehr dahinter steckt. Und wie sich zeigt, gibt es nicht wenige Verdächtige, die ein Interesse an Tegans Verschwinden haben könnten. Die Ermittlungen laufen noch, als sich bei der Premiere ein weiterer Zwischenfall ereignet... (Senderinfo).

programme.title: Hudson & Rex
programme.desc: Der Mörder Billy Mumford nimmt beim Versuch, aus seiner Haft zu fliehen, zwei Polizeibeamte als Geiseln. Charlie muss die Situation klären. Er setzt konsequent auf Deeskalation, und fordert das SWAT Team an, doch die Situation ist komplex. Mit Rex' Hilfe kann eine der Geiseln entkommen und Charlie tauscht sich selbst gegen die andere Geisel aus... (Senderinfo).

programme.title: Hudson & Rex
programme.desc: In den letzten vier Folgen der Staffel werden einige lose Enden zusammengeführt. So machen Charlie und Sarah (Mayko Nguyen) ihre Beziehung endlich öffentlich. Auf beruflicher Ebene bekommt es Charlie mit dem 14 Jahre alten Entführungsfall von Alison Anders zu tun.

programme.title: Sea Patrol
programme.desc: Explosives Staffelfinale der preisgekrönten Serie. An Bord der „Hammersley“ sieht die Navy-Crew, wie ein Schiff in die Luft fliegt. Drahtzieher Ray Walsman wird verhaftet – doch der Milliardär kann fliehen. Das nächste Problem: Auf der „Hammersley“ schleicht ein Profikiller umher…\nDie Serie wurde 2011 nach Staffel fünf eingestellt.

programme.title: Sea Patrol
programme.desc: Nikki ist überglücklich als ET ihr einen Heiratsantrag macht. Er verrät ihr auch, dass er aus der Marine austreten möchte um sich ganz seinem Hobby, dem Korallentauchen, hinzugeben. Bald bricht ET zu einem neuen Auftrag auf, doch als die Hammersley überraschend auslaufen muss, ist er noch nicht zurückgekehrt. Kurz darauf macht die Crew einen entsetzlichen Fund. (Senderinfo).

programme.title: Sea Patrol
programme.desc: Durch den Tod von ET schwer getroffen fällt es der Crew der Hammersley sehr schwer, seinen Nachfolger an Board willkommen zu heißen. 2 Dads, wie der selbstverliebte Leading Seaman genannt wird, stößt nicht nur bei Nikki auf Ablehnung. programme.title: Mr Bean *2002
programme.desc: Mr Bean et Teddy n'ont rien de prévu et décident de rester au lit toute la journée. Mr Bean doit trouver des moyens ingénieux pour se nourrir sans bouger.

programme.title: Mr Bean *2002
programme.desc: Après avoir vu le kart électrique tape-à-l'oeil que monsieur Paliwal a acheté pour sa fille, Mr Bean et Billy construisent le leur à l'aide d'objets trouvés.

programme.title: Grizzy et les lemmings
programme.desc: Les lemmings ont organisé un spectacle de magie dans le salon de la cabane. Voulant s'y installer pour regarder la télé, Grizzy se débarrasse des lemmings.

programme.title: Grizzy et les lemmings
programme.desc: Grizzy ne sait plus comment stopper le nouveau jeu de balles des lemmings. Ceux-ci s'amusent à esquiver des sphères de pierres magiques qui virevoltent dans la cabane.

programme.title: Grizzy et les lemmings
programme.desc: Grizzy et les lemmings ont un nouveau jeu : ils s'affrontent pour gagner une couronne qu'ils doivent mettre sur la tête d'une petite peluche à leur image.

programme.title: Grizzy et les lemmings
programme.desc: Pour pouvoir faire la sieste, Grizzy fait déguerpir les lemmings, mais l'un d'entre eux se retrouve projeté à l'écart des autres dans une étrange crypte.

programme.title: Oggy et les cafards
programme.desc: Par une nouvelle facétie des cafards, le cerveau de Jack, guère plus gros qu'un pois chiche, se trouve malencontreusement éjecté de son crâne.

programme.title: Oggy et les cafards
programme.desc: Bob se retrouve plâtré de partout après un accident provoqué par Oggy. Pour se racheter, le chat insiste pour s'occuper de lui.

programme.title: Oggy et les cafards
programme.desc: C'est la relève de la station spatiale qui gravite autour de la Terre. Le fier spationaute chargé de cette délicate mission n'est autre qu'Oggy.

programme.title: Zig & Sharko
programme.desc: Sharko casse le dauphin en porcelaine de Poséidon et fait accuser Zig à sa place. Pour punir Zig, le roi des mers l'enferme dans un pendentif.

programme.title: Zig & Sharko
programme.desc: Marina refuse de quitter ses claquettes pour entrer dans un restaurant chic, alors que Sharko accepte de s'y plier. Voyant ça, Zig impose toutes sortes d'interdictions au requin.

programme.title: Zig & Sharko
programme.desc: Marina casse le fil du cerf-volant de Sharko qui s'envole. Un étrange vaisseau-nuage, piloté par Zig et Bernie, lui permet de courser le cerf-volant dans le ciel.

programme.title: Les Aventures de Bernie
programme.desc: En voyant Barbara jouer avec son morse apprivoisé, Bernie a l'idée d'entrainer Nora à suivre ses ordres pour qu'elle l'aide à aller retrouver Zig... Nora s'avère aussi enthousiaste que fantasque….

programme.title: Les Aventures de Bernie
programme.desc: Lorsqu'en jouant Nora se blesse accidentellement à cause de Bernie et Georges. Tous deux se précipitent pour la soigner. Une compétition s'installe entre les mollusques à tel point qu'ils en oublient leur amie Nora.

programme.title: Les Aventures de Bernie
programme.desc: En voyant le camion de la poste, Bernie a une idée : il va se cacher à l'intérieur d'un colis et se faire livrer chez Zig ! Mais le trajet est semé d'embûches et Bernie doit trouver des solutions pour arriver à destination.

programme.title: Scooby-Doo et la créature des ténèbres
programme.desc: Krudsky le Magnifique, un magicien de carnaval raté, dérobe la lumière magique à Willow, la princesse des fées. Scooby-Doo et Sammy réagissent.

programme.title: Mr Bean *2002
programme.desc: Mrs Wicket part pour le week-end et demande à Mr Bean de nourrir son chat Scrapper très tôt le matin. Il a alors l'idée d'inventer une machine à nourrir.

programme.title: Mr Bean *2002
programme.desc: Mr Bean fait semblant d'être malade et demande à Irma toutes sortes de services. Tout va bien jusqu'à ce que la mère d'Irma arrive et s'en mêle.

programme.title: Mr Bean *2002
programme.desc: Les voisins de Mr Bean veulent remporter le titre de "plus jolie rue de Grande-Bretagne". Mr Bean invente un dispositif de nettoyage des vitres pour aider la rue à gagner.

programme.title: Mr Bean *2002
programme.desc: Mr Bean construit une sculpture de neige pour l'anniversaire d'Irma. Malheureusement, le soleil fait son apparition, et son oeuvre menace de fondre.

programme.title: Mr Magoo *2019

programme.title: Grizzy et les lemmings

programme.title: Mr Bean *2002

programme.title: Mr Bean *2002

programme.title: Mr Bean *2002

programme.title: Lamput

Entre Skinny qui va de danger en danger et Specs mort de trouille, Lamput va devoir jouer les anges gardiens. Et si le somnambule finit catapulté sur la Lune, ce n'est peut-être pas plus mal.

programme.title: Lamput
programme.desc: Les Docs proposent une récompense à quiconque capturera Lamput. Très vite, une vieille dame se présente avec Lamput sous le bras. Comble de l'audace, elle exige de toucher la récompense. Les Docs sont loin d'avoir la somme en question. Désespérés, ils se.

programme.title: Lamput

programme.title: Oggy et les cafards

programme.title: Oggy et les cafards

Ils flanquent une pagaille monstrueuse à laquelle Oggy tente de remédier comme il peut. Mais lorsque, par mégarde, il avale le sifflet ça devient carrément du délire...

programme.title: Tom et Jerry Show

programme.title: Mama's Family
programme.desc: Thelma "Mama" Harper is the quick-tempered, blue-haired matriarch of the Harper family who lives with son Vint and his wife, Naomi, who were forced to move into Mama's basement after losing money in a business deal gone awry. After Vint's kids from a previous marriage leave the house, Mama's delinquent grandson Bubba is ordered to live with his grandmother after being released from juvenile hall and placed on probation. Iola Boylen, Thelma's friend and neighbor, is a frequent visitor to the Harper household, which is often the site of bickering between abrasive Mama and her loved ones. Vicki Lawrence stars as Mama, a character she originated in sketches on "The Carol Burnett Show.".

programme.title: Les faits Karl Zéro
programme.desc: Le 24 mai 2014, un tueur abat quatre personnes au musée juif de Bruxelles : un couple d'Israéliens, une bénévole française et un employé belge. Quelques jours plus tard, Mehdi Nemmouche, un Français de 29 ans originaire de Roubaix, est arrêté à Marseille, en possession d'armes lourdes. Il venait de passer plus d'un an en Syrie et était fiché par la DGSI. Le procureur a précisé que Mehdi Nemmouche

programme.title: Indices
programme.desc: Jeudi 23 février 2017, Nantes en Loire Atlantique. La police est appelée pour une disparition inquiétante, celle de Brigitte Troadec 49 ans. Sa sœur est inquiète, elle n'a plus de nouvelles de Brigitte depuis six jours. Les policiers se rendent au domicile de la famille Troadec. La maison est vide.

programme.title: Flics tueurs
programme.desc: A la fois fascinante et perturbante, cette toute nouvelle série lève le voile sur la trahison ultime de la confiance : lorsque des policiers deviennent des tueurs. Elle révèle au grand jour les manipulations et la planification qui ont précédé chaque crime, ainsi que la manière dont les auteurs ont utilisé leur formation policière pour tenter de dissimuler leurs traces.

programme.title: Un tueur dans ma famille
programme.desc: Joanne Dennehy a vécu une histoire d'amour tumultueuse à l'adolescence avec son petit ami John Trainor. Elle est devenue mère de deux enfants mais a abandonné sa famille pour se lancer dans une folie meurtrière. En 2013, poussée par une "pulsion sadique", Dennehy a poignardé à mort trois hommes en l'espace de dix jours.

programme.title: Faites entrer l'accusé
programme.desc: En 1980, en Charente, Michel Maury-Laribière, vice-président du Conseil national du Patronat français, est enlevé. En octobre, la police coince son ravisseur à Tours. Il prend douze ans de prison pour l'enlèvement de Maury-Laribière et vingt ans pour le meurtre, en cavale, d'un gérant de discothèque.

programme.title: Bionik – Die besten Ideen der Natur
programme.desc: Zu den großen Sinneskünstlern des Tierreichs gehören der Seehund, dessen Schnurrhaare Wasserturbulenzen über 30 Sekunden nach ihrer Entstehung wahrnehmen können, afrikanische Elefanten, die Geräusche aus einer Entfernung von über zwei Kilometern mit ihren Füßen spüren, und Fledermäuse, deren Fähigkeit zur Echoortung das Leben von blinden Menschen leichter machen kann. programme.title: Bionik – Die besten Ideen der Natur
programme.desc: Tiere müssen unter extremen Bedingungen überleben – in Eiswüsten, der Tiefsee oder auf den höchsten Gebirgen. Dazu brauchen sie die denkbar beste Ausrüstung. In der Vergangenheit musste die Evolution dafür immer gewieftere Baupläne und Rezepturen entwickeln. Wenn wir Menschen genau hinsehen, finden wir dort die Lösung für viele unserer eigenen kniffligsten technischen Probleme. (Senderinfo).

programme.title: Bionik – Die besten Ideen der Natur
programme.desc: Die Evolution ist ein Wettlauf ums Überleben. Dabei hat die Natur verblüffende Lösungen hervorgebracht, die uns heute inspirieren: Exoskelette helfen, Menschen das Gehen zu erleichtern, die Tarnkunst des Tintenfischs fließt in Militärtechnik ein, und der lautlose Flug der Eule macht moderne Lüfter leiser. Antworten aus der Natur treiben unseren Fortschritt voran. (Senderinfo).

programme.title: Insekten entschlüsselt
programme.desc: Insekten sind überall. Auf ihren Spuren erhält man Einblick in einen außergewöhnlichen Mikrokosmos, und es offenbaren sich einige der größten Wunder der Natur. Tierfilmer Alex Jones reist nach Arizona, wo er seiner Leidenschaft für die Beobachtung von Käfern nachgeht. Die Erkundung der Welt dieser winzigen Krabbeltiere liefert dem Menschen riesige Erkenntnisse. (Senderinfo).

programme.title: Requiem in Weiss – Das würdelose Sterben unserer Gletscher
programme.desc: Die Gletscher der Ostalpen sterben unumkehrbar. Während das Eis schwindet und der Permafrost zerfällt, laufen die Seilbahnen, Schneekanonen donnern, Touristen strömen. Die Landschaft wird neu geformt. Dies ist ein visuell eindringliches Abschiedsdokument. Wissenschaft trifft Emotion und stellt eine Frage, die uns alle betrifft: Wie verabschieden wir uns? (Senderinfo).

programme.title: Der Extrembergsteiger
programme.desc: Er mag’s gern schwer. Und allein ist schwerer. Solo, ohne Sauerstoff oder Träger und vorzugsweise im unwirtlichen Winter zieht es Jost Kobusch auf die höchsten Berge der Welt. Eine Nahtoderfahrung bei der Besteigung des Mount Everest bewertete der 26-Jährige als „immens positives Erlebnis“.

programme.title: Auto Motor Party

Auf fünf Rennstrecken lassen mehr als tausend Fahrer ihre PS-Muskeln spielen, ob beim Drag-Racing, Stockcar oder Traktor-Pulling. Ein Stelldichein außergewöhnlicher Boliden. (Senderinfo).

programme.title: Benzin meets Kerosin
programme.desc: Blitzender Chrom, bollernde V8-Motoren und kreischende Zweitakter – einmal im Jahr treffen sich Motorverrückte auf dem Wings & Wheels-Festival in Uetersen. Mehr als eintausend Oldtimer, Custom-Bikes und PS-starke Classic-Cars tummeln sich dann auf einem kleinen Flugplatz vor den Toren Hamburgs. Ein Highlight des benzingetränkten Wochenendes: spektakuläre Flug-Stunts am Himmel. (Senderinfo).

programme.title: Wilde Wege
programme.desc: Im Nordosten Georgiens führt der Abano-Pass, die höchste befahrbare Straße im Großen Kaukasus, auf fast 3000 Meter Höhe. Sie windet sich über steile Hänge und durch wilde Pfade, vorbei an rauer, beeindruckender Natur. Eine Fahrt über diesen Pass ist eine abenteuerliche Reise in die majestätische Welt des Hochgebirges. (Senderinfo).

programme.title: Wilde Wege
programme.desc: Der Trans Sulawesi Highway zählt zu Asiens wildesten Straßen. Er durchquert Indonesiens viertgrößte Insel und verbindet Strände, Städte und Urwälder. Doch die Fahrt hat es in sich: Die Straße ist laut, überfüllt, chaotisch – und oft gefährlich. Nur wer starke Nerven hat, stellt sich diesem abenteuerlichen Weg durch Sulawesis beeindruckende Landschaft. (Senderinfo).

Doch es gelingt ihr, ihm zu entkommen. Sie erreicht die Mall, wo Trudy sie sofort in die Mangel nimmt. Auf dem Fest ist die Stimmung auch nicht mehr die Beste. Salene tanzt zu viel mit Bray, was Danni auf den Plan ruft.

programme.title: The Tribe - Eine Welt ohne Erwachsene
programme.desc: Patsy glaubt an Gespenster, und dann steht plötzlich Ebony vor ihr! Doch Ebony hat zu Recht eine irdische Wut auf Patsy! Daher verlangt sie von ihr, dass sie ihr alles über Trudy und deren Verbindung zu den Chosen erzählt.

programme.title: The Tribe - Eine Welt ohne Erwachsene
programme.desc: Danni und die restlichen Anführer werden von den Chosen gefangengehalten. Vergeblich versucht Danni, die anderen davon zu überzeugen, dass sie gemeinsam stärker sind als die Chosen. Einer nach dem anderen ergibt sich. Nur Danni bleibt weiterhin standhaft. Dann erscheint Wolf mit einem Ultimatum vom Guardian: Bray muss sich bis zum Mittag des nächsten Tages ergeben, sonst sieht er Danni nie wieder.

programme.title: The Tribe - Eine Welt ohne Erwachsene
programme.desc: Gemeinsam mit Lex, Ryan und Bray entwickelt Jack einen Plan, um Danni mithilfe einer Rauchwolke zu retten. Zur Unterstützung versucht Lex, auch die Kinder der anderen Stämme zu mobilisieren. Dies bleibt jedoch erfolglos.

programme.title: The Tribe - Eine Welt ohne Erwachsene

programme.title: Pacific Blue - Die Strandpolizei
programme.desc: Als T.C. auf seine Jugendliebe Rebecca trifft, freut er sich inständig. Allerdings ahnt er nicht, dass sie kriminell geworden ist und ihr Wiedersehen Teil eines heimtückischen Plans ist. Sie bringt ihn dadurch sogar in Lebensgefahr.

programme.title: Pacific Blue - Die Strandpolizei
programme.desc: Cory und T.C. werden bei einem gewaltsamen Banküberfall als Geiseln genommen. Als die Gangster erkennen, dass die beiden Polizisten sind, wird die Situation gefährlicher. Zudem setzen bei einer hochschwangeren Frau die Wehen ein.

programme.title: Nash Bridges

Die Biker-Cops können einen neuen Mord gerade noch verhindern.

programme.title: Pacific Blue - Die Strandpolizei
programme.desc: T.C. verliert bei einer wilden Verfolgungsjagd seine Dienstwaffe. Als er sie sich zurückholen will, ist sie bereits längst in fremden Händen und wird sogar für einen Mord eingesetzt. Er versucht verzweifelt, seine Pistole zurückzubekommen.

programme.title: The Outpost
programme.desc: Wren geht die Konfrontation mit ihrer Mutter Yavalla an, als Janzo, Talon und Zed einen Attentatsversuch unternehmen. Yavalla muss Stärke zeigen. Währenddessen wird Tobins Loyalität infrage gestellt.

programme.title: The Outpost
programme.desc: Ein Verkäufer von Schlangenöl trifft im Außenposten ein und verspricht Heilung, doch Janzo ist misstrauisch. Tobins Frau legt ihren Gebrauch von Red Kinj offen und wird dafür ins Gefängnis geworfen. Talon sucht nach Antworten über ihren Vater.

programme.title: Undercover

programme.title: Undercover

programme.title: Undercover

Die Veranstaltung läuft aus dem Ruder und Zori gerät in Lebensgefahr. Ivo gibt den Befehl, sie zu töten, doch da bekommt er es mit Rossen zu tun.

programme.title: Undercover
programme.desc: Jaro hat herausgefunden, dass Martin ein Verräter ist, und erteilt einen Mordauftrag, von dem Martin nichts ahnt. programme.title: Tatort Traumschiff
programme.desc: Während einer Kreuzfahrt verschwindet die Tochter einer Familie. Die Umstände sind bis heute unklar.

programme.title: Tatort Traumschiff

programme.title: Sonic X

programme.title: Sonic X
programme.desc: Sonic versteckt sich auf einem Planeten, während ihr Schiff repariert wird. Eggman nutzt die Zeit, um Sonic zu jagen. Er hängt einen Steckbrief in einer Kneipe aus und sendet eine Warnung. Die Spannung steigt für die gestrandeten Helden.

programme.title: Sonic X

programme.title: Sonic X

programme.title: Sonic X
programme.desc: Cosmo ist eine Metarex-Spionin und ein versteckter Sender verrät Sonics Pläne. Sonic ist erschüttert. Rouge und Amy erkunden Cosmos Heimat und treffen Earthia. Sie decken die wahre Geschichte des Planeten auf und alle Geheimnisse kommen ans Licht.

programme.title: Sonic X

programme.title: Sonic X

programme.title: The Tribe - Eine Welt ohne Erwachsene

programme.title: The Tribe - Eine Welt ohne Erwachsene

programme.title: The Tribe - Eine Welt ohne Erwachsene
programme.desc: Bray ist wütend und verwirrt, weil Pride Ambers Ring trägt. Er weiß nicht mehr weiter und traut Pride nicht, obwohl dieser ihn gerettet hat. Er setzt sich in den Kopf, dass er unbedingt die geheimnisvolle Eagle kennenlernen muss.

programme.title: The Tribe - Eine Welt ohne Erwachsene
programme.desc: Die Gaians sind nicht gerade erfreut, als Bray einfach in Ambers Hütte stürmt und ungerührt eine Erklärung von ihr verlangt. Sie erinnert sich daran zurück, wie Ebony ihr nach dem Brand die schreckliche Wahrheit über Bray erzählt hat.

programme.title: Bluey
programme.desc: Dad hat sich einfach auf das eine Ende der Wippe gesetzt. Also trommeln Bluey und Bingo den ganzen Spielplatz zusammen, um ihn gemeinsam zu verjagen, aber sie brauchen noch einen Freund mehr. (Senderinfo).

programme.title: Bluey
programme.desc: Bluey geht zum ersten Mal ins Kino, aber sie hat Angst, dass der Film zu gruselig sein könnte. Als Bingo im Kino durchdreht, muss sie ihre Angst überwinden und Dad helfen. (Senderinfo).

programme.title: Bluey
programme.desc: Opa soll sich eigentlich ausruhen, aber als Bluey und Bingo ihn besuchen wollen, macht er sich mit den Kindern aus dem Staub und nimmt sie mit auf ein verrücktes Abenteuer in den Busch. (Senderinfo).

programme.title: Bluey
programme.desc: Als Muffins Vater ihr sagt, dass sie etwas Besonderes ist, interpretiert sie das als Ausrede, alles zu tun was sie will, also müssen sie und Bluey nach ihren Regeln Bibliothek spielen. (Senderinfo).

programme.title: Spidey und seine Super-Freunde
programme.desc: Das Spidey-Team muss Tante May retten, als ein neues Gerät des Grünen Kobolds die Leute glauben lässt, sie seien Piraten und sie auf Beutefang schickt.; Doc Ock schiebt dem Spidey-Team eine böse Doppelgänger-Version des Spidey-Bots TRACE-E unter, um die Helden in eine Falle zu locken. (Senderinfo).

programme.desc: Mit einem Wunsch verwandelt Sofia ihre Mutter versehentlich in ein Kind.; Als Camila bei einem Schulprojekt von niedlichen Wauz-Hörnern überrannt wird, eilt Sofia ihr zu Hilfe. (Senderinfo).

programme.title: Magicampers

programme.title: Modern Family
programme.desc: Cam vergisst den Text seines liebsten Country-Songs und schiebt Mitch die Schuld in die Schuhe. Er will sich wieder mehr auf seine Wurzeln konzentrieren und beschließt, ein Huhn zu kaufen. Unterdessen versucht Alex, einen Regierungsjob zu bekommen, allerdings muss dafür die ganze Familie befragt werden, was zu heillosem Chaos führt. Haley und Dylan merken, dass es Zeit wird, erwachsener zu werden.

programme.title: Modern Family
programme.desc: Haley braucht einen mütterlichen Rat von Claire, denn sie wägt ihre Zukunft mit Dylan und ihre Karriere ab. Unterdessen bringen Jays und Cams unorthodoxe Trainingsmethoden den beiden eine Nachhilfe in Sachen Sensibilität von Manny und Phil ein, und Mitch trifft auf Phils Erzfeind Gil. (Senderinfo).

programme.title: Dharma & Greg
programme.desc: Dharma und Greg sitzen in einem Restaurant, als Gregs ehemalige Freundin, die Anwältin Barbara, auftaucht. Barbara ist überrascht: Sie war zwei Jahre mit Greg zusammen, und er hat ihr nie einen Heiratsantrag gemacht. Im Gegenteil: Die Beziehung scheiterte letztlich daran, dass Greg nie heiraten wollte... (Senderinfo).

programme.title: Dharma & Greg
programme.desc: Dharmas Vater Larry hat einen Schnellkurs zum Thema "Wie werde ich richtig reich" absolviert. Plötzlich ist er ganz versessen aufs Geldverdienen. Also schlägt er Gregs Vater Ed ein Geschäft vor: Er möchte eine Videokassette produzieren, auf der Dharma Yoga-Unterricht erteilt... (Senderinfo).

programme.title: Dharma & Greg
programme.desc: Dharma lernt beim Sonnenbaden zufällig einen Indianer kennen, der sich auf dem Dach ihres Hauses niedergelassen hat. Er beabsichtigt, dort zu sterben. Das Gebäude steht an der Stelle, an der seine Vorfahren früher einen Friedhof hatten. Dharma lädt ihn kurz entschlossen zu sich in die Wohnung ein, damit er dort seine letzten Tage verbringen kann... (Senderinfo).

programme.title: Skispringen: Vierschanzentournee
programme.desc: Zuletzt stand ein deutscher Skispringer in der Saison 2017/2018 auf dem Podium in Innsbruck. Damals belegte Andreas Wellinger hinter Kamil Stoch und Daniel-André Tande den dritten Platz. Bei der jüngsten Ausgabe landete Wellinger auf Platz 13. (Senderinfo).

programme.title: Skispringen: Vierschanzentournee
programme.desc: Der Kampf um den Gesamtsieg war 2025 eine enge Angelegenheit: Daniel Tschofenig setzte sich mit nur 1,4 Zählern Vorsprung vor Jan Hörl durch. (Senderinfo).

programme.title: Snooker: Northern Ireland Open
programme.desc: Im Finale der diesjährigen Northern Ireland Open besiegte der Engländer Kyren Wilson den Waliser Jak Jones mit 9:2. Nach 2024 war dies sein zweiter Sieg bei diesem Turnier und sein elfter Titel bei einem Rankingsturnier. (Senderinfo).

programme.title: Snooker: Shanghai Masters
programme.desc: Im Finale trafen die damalige Weltnummer 1, Judd Trump, und der Titelverteidiger, Kyren Wilson, aufeinander. Nach der Nachmittagssession führte Trump 7:3. Auch am Abend dominierte er und gewann mit 11:6. Nach 2024 war es sein zweiter Titel bei den Shanghai Masters. (Senderinfo).

programme.title: Biathlon: Weltcup
programme.desc: Der Biathlon-Weltcup 2026/27 wird vom 24. November 2026 bis zum 21. März 2027 an insgesamt zehn verschiedenen Austragungsorten stattfinden. programme.title: Fati i Ushtarit
programme.desc: Scott Eastwood, Colin Hanks. Gjatë Betejës së Ardenëve, në Luftën e Dytë Botërore, një kapiten amerikan mbetet i vetmi i mbijetuar i njësisë së tij, i bllokuar pas vijave armike. I plagosur dhe i izoluar, ai duhet të përdorë zgjuarsinë dhe aftësitë e tij për të shmangur trupat gjermane dhe për t’u kthyer në linjat aleate.

programme.title: Patrulla e Putrave: Aventura me Dinosaurët
programme.desc: Pas një stuhie misterioze, anija e Patrullës së Putrave përplaset në një ishull tropikal të panjohur, të banuar nga dinosaurët. Atje, këlyshët takojnë Rex-in, një qenush që ka mbetur i bllokuar prej vitesh dhe është bërë ekspert i botës parahistorike. Por kur planet e kryetarit Humdinger shkaktojnë shpërthimin e një vullkani, ekipi duhet të bashkojë forcat për të shpëtuar ishullin.

programme.title: Hipoteza e dashurisë
programme.desc: Lili Reinhart, Tom Bateman. Për të bindur miqtë se ka një lidhje, një studente doktorature nis një romancë të shtirur me një profesor. Por ajo që fillon si një marrëveshje e leverdishme, shndërrohet në një histori dashurie të papritur.

programme.title: Nata e Djallit 6: Nga Bota e Përtejme
programme.desc: Gemma, një nënë e re që jeton me vajzën në shtëpinë ku është rritur, zbulon se mund të udhëtojë në botën e shpirtrave dhe të sjellë qeniet e mbinatyrshme në botën e të gjallëve. Kur forcat e errëta zbulojnë aftësinë e saj, ajo përballet me një kërcënim që rrezikon gjithçka. Kapitulli i ri i sagës horror ”Nata e Djallit”.

programme.title: Mundësia e fundit
programme.desc: Ish-ushtari i forcave speciale Jake Harris rikthehet në aksion kur ish-shoku i tij i armëve, tashmë terrorist, merr peng krerët e ushtrisë amerikane në një bunker bërthamor. Me kohën që po mbaron, Harris duhet të përballet me një ushtri mercenarësh për të ndaluar vjedhjen e kodeve bërthamore dhe një katastrofë globale.

programme.desc: Scott Eastwood, Colin Hanks. Gjatë Betejës së Ardenëve, në Luftën e Dytë Botërore, një kapiten amerikan mbetet i vetmi i mbijetuar i njësisë së tij, i bllokuar pas vijave armike. I plagosur dhe i izoluar, ai duhet të përdorë zgjuarsinë dhe aftësitë e tij për të shmangur trupat gjermane dhe për t’u kthyer në linjat aleate.

programme.title: Mundësia e fundit
programme.desc: Ish-ushtari i forcave speciale Jake Harris rikthehet në aksion kur ish-shoku i tij i armëve, tashmë terrorist, merr peng krerët e ushtrisë amerikane në një bunker bërthamor. Me kohën që po mbaron, Harris duhet të përballet me një ushtri mercenarësh për të ndaluar vjedhjen e kodeve bërthamore dhe një katastrofë globale.

programme.title: Patrulla e Putrave: Aventura me Dinosaurët
programme.desc: Pas një stuhie misterioze, anija e Patrullës së Putrave përplaset në një ishull tropikal të panjohur, të banuar nga dinosaurët. Atje, këlyshët takojnë Rex-in, një qenush që ka mbetur i bllokuar prej vitesh dhe është bërë ekspert i botës parahistorike. Por kur planet e kryetarit Humdinger shkaktojnë shpërthimin e një vullkani, ekipi duhet të bashkojë forcat për të shpëtuar ishullin.

programme.title: Hipoteza e dashurisë
programme.desc: Lili Reinhart, Tom Bateman. Për të bindur miqtë se ka një lidhje, një studente doktorature nis një romancë të shtirur me një profesor. Por ajo që fillon si një marrëveshje e leverdishme, shndërrohet në një histori dashurie të papritur.

programme.title: Nata e Djallit 6: Nga Bota e Përtejme
programme.desc: Gemma, një nënë e re që jeton me vajzën në shtëpinë ku është rritur, zbulon se mund të udhëtojë në botën e shpirtrave dhe të sjellë qeniet e mbinatyrshme në botën e të gjallëve. Kur forcat e errëta zbulojnë aftësinë e saj, ajo përballet me një kërcënim që rrezikon gjithçka. Kapitulli i ri i sagës horror ”Nata e Djallit”.

programme.desc: Près d'un siècle après la mort de Mata Hari, Franck Ferrand s'intéresse de près à ce personnage trouble et sulfureux. L'égérie de la Belle Epoque, devenue célèbre grâce à son numéro d'effeuillage sur des danses orientales, était-elle véritablement un agent double ? programme.title: L'ombre d'un doute
programme.desc: Le 29 septembre 1902, Emile Zola, homme de lettres de génie, alors au sommet de sa gloire, est retrouvé mort. Bien que le décès soit survenu dans des circonstances pour le moins étranges, il est jugé accidentel. Pourtant, 26 ans après la disparition de l'écrivain, à bord d'un train de banlieue, un homme avoue à son interlocuteur qu'il a assassiné Zola. Sa confession est-elle crédible ?

programme.title: L'ombre d'un doute
programme.desc: Gros plan sur trois familles qui étaient à bord du Titanic lors de son naufrage, le 14 avril 1912. programme.title: Mesures actives

programme.title: Biélorussie : au coeur de la révolte
programme.desc: Depuis la répression sanglante des manifestations de 2020, la Biélorussie est devenue le pays le plus inaccessible d'Europe. programme.title: L'ombre d'un doute
programme.desc: En mai 1610, alors que l'attelage qui transporte Henri IV est bloqué par un encombrement, en plein coeur de Paris, un colosse se jette sur le roi, qu'il transperce de trois coups de poignard. Si le monarque semble avoir été victime d'un fanatique religieux, des rumeurs de complot ne tardent pas à circuler.

programme.title: L'ombre d'un doute

programme.desc: Prindërit ”mendje-hapur” të Suzit janë të ftuar për darkë, dhe Stiv është i shqetësuar. Ndjekja e një dokumentari mbi marrdhëniet e kafshëve në çift nuk i vjen shumë në ndihmë. Ndërkohë, Xhejn ka zhvilluar një aftësi të veçantë. Ajo mund të përcaktojë cili do të ishte kandidati ideal VIP i personave të ndryshëm, thjesht duke u hedhur atyre një vështrim. Mariela Frostrap është idhulli i saj televiziv...

programme.title: Ole
programme.desc: Massimo Boldi, Vincenzo Salemme, Daryl Hannah. Dy mësues që s’e durojnë dot njëri tjetrin, shoqërojnë një grup fëmijësh në një udhëtim në Spanjë. E sikur mos mjaftonte gjithë mospëlqimi, ata bien edhe në dashuri me të njëjtën vajzë.

programme.title: S2E2 - Grupi

programme.title: Aleksa dhe Keti
