programme.title: Spiunia Herriet
programme.desc: Spiunia më e suksesshme 11 vjeçare e botës quhet Herrieta. Në fakt, ajo ëndërron të bëhet shkrimtare dhe shkruan për gjithçka që i zë syri. Një ditë shokët e saj do të gjejnë bllokun e shënimeve dhe sekrete e saj zbulohen.

programme.title: Sfida e fundit
programme.desc: Në botën e egër të sportit, Keila mendon se është më e mira, ndërsa i talentuari Uill, ka prekur fundin... Një ditë, ajo përballet me të vërtetën... Ndërsa Uilli, me frikën e tij më të madhe... Por sëbashku ata do të rrezikojnë gjithçka, për të prekur majat.

programme.title: Tribu
programme.desc: Në sezonin e tretë - Mall Rats rikthehen në qytet për të rindërtuar jetën, por përplasjet mes fiseve, aleancat e brishta dhe sekretet e së kaluarës rrezikojnë të shkatërrojnë gjithçka që kanë ndërtuar.

programme.title: Hani
programme.desc: Hani është një kërcimtare dhe koreografe mjaft e talentuar dhe një ditë fati i troket në derë duke i realizuar ëndrrën e saj më të madhe. Por ajo do të kuptojë se në fakt dëshira e saj e vërtetë e zemrës është një tjetër.

programme.title: Si të krijosh djalin ideal
programme.desc: Mea dhe Gebi janë dy vajzat më të zgjuara të klasës. Por përsa i përket pjesës tjetër, e kanë pak të vashtirë.Tani, ajo që nisi si një lojë, bëhet më e vërtetë se kurrë...

programme.title: S0E12 - Krenari dhe Respekt
programme.desc: Pasi Jiti e lë në shtëpi, gjendja e Zelihasë përkeqësohet. Vdekja e Namëkut trondit Sadullahun dhe Nihatin. Jiti përgatit planin për të grabitur Sadullahun. Kybra dhe Jiti takohen përsëri, por këtë herë në shtëpinë e tij. Ç’plan ka Jiti për florinjtë e vjedhur?

programme.title: S0E46 - Dashuri Bardhezi
programme.desc: Ferhati dhe Asllëja gatuajnë së bashku, por asnjëri nuk e prek temën e divorcit. Abidini i propozon Gylsymit për martesë. Si do të reagojë ajo? Me lejen e Ferhatit, Asllëja dhe Abidini shkojnë të marrin Gylsymin dhe Jeterin. A do të pranojnë ato të kthehen në shtëpi?

programme.title: S0E167 - Për Tim Bir
programme.desc: Serial/ Dramë: Aishegyli dhe Pojrazi vazhdojnë të ndjekin planet e tyre në bashkëpunim me kryeprokurorin. Songyli kërkon medoemos që ta ndajë Sadretinin nga Begumi. Çfarë ka kurdisur ajo këtë herë? Ndërkohë Nesheti i shpreh ndjenjat e tij Aishegylit . Si do ta presë kjo e fundit?

programme.title: S0E73 - Rënia e Gjetheve
programme.desc: Ali Rizai mëson sa shumë të vërteta i janë fshehur dhe e drejton zemërimin edhe ndaj Fikretit. E lënduar, ajo vendos t’i qëndrojë planit për t’u martuar me Tahsinin. Ndërkohë, Oguzi dhe Nexhla përgatiten të largohen drejt Gjermanisë, por Shevketi zbulon udhëtimin e tyre.

programme.title: S0E9 - Loja e Fatit
programme.desc: Ndarja e Tuçes nga Ryzgari e gëzon Adën, por ai këmbëngul se është i dashuruar me Tuçen. Bora pranon të takojë gruan me të cilën ka shkëmbyer mesazhe, ndërsa Ada përpiqet ta çojë planin e saj deri në fund. Kur takimi dështon, mbrëmja i afron papritur Adën dhe Borën.

programme.title: S0E13 - Krenari dhe Respekt
programme.desc: Jiti vë në zbatim planin e tij. Do të rezultojë i suksesshëm? Kybra nuk ndihet mirë. Ç’po ndodh me të? Sadullahu niset të vrasë Jitin. Si do ta ndalojë Kybra këtë? Emiri fillon të dyshojë për dosjet që shefi i tij i dha për shqyrtim. Njerku i Derjas nuk di të ndalet, si do të shkojë puna e saj?

programme.title: S0E47 - Dashuri Bardhezi
programme.desc: Jeteri kthehet në shtëpi. Si do ta presin familjarët e tjerë? Gylsymi pranon propozimin e Abidinit. Ky i fundit takohet me Ferhatin dhe i tregon për propozimin që i ka bërë Gylsymit. A do ta pranojë Ferhati këtë gjë?

programme.desc: Serial/ Dramë: Çfarë marrëveshjeje do të bëjë Sema me kryeprokurorin për të liruar Pojrazin dhe të tjerët? Policia arrin të ndalojë një sasi të madhe droge në port falë informacioneve që ka marrë nga Aishegyli. Çfarë do të bëjë Ihsani për të zbuluar spiunin mes radhëve të tyre?

programme.title: S0E74 - Rënia e Gjetheve
programme.desc: Fikreti martohet fshehurazi me Tahsinin, ndërsa ndërhyrja e policisë në aeroport pengon largimin e Oguzit dhe Nexhlës. Padia e Jamanit i lë të bllokuar në Stamboll, pa rrugëdaljen që kishin shpresuar. Ali Rizai përpiqet të afrohet me Fikretin, pa e ditur vendimin që ajo ka marrë.

programme.title: S0E10 - Loja e Fatit
programme.desc: Një udhëtim pune në mal i jep Tuçes mundësinë t’i afrohet Borës, por Ada kërkon të kthehet duke përdorur si justifikim sëmundjen e tezes. Defekti i makinës i lë të bllokuar dhe ardhja e Ryzgarit e ndërlikon situatën. Të detyruar të kalojnë natën aty, të katërt përballen me xhelozi dhe të papritura.

programme.title: S0E14 - Krenari dhe Respekt
programme.desc: Jiti i kërkon Kybrës të abortojë fëmijën. Derja është në telashe të mëdha. Ç’ka ndodhur me të? Sibeli mëson se nëna e saj merr para nga Bora. Do të largohet ajo nga shtëpia? Si do ta zgjidhin Jiti dhe Emiri problemin e Derjas?

programme.title: S0E48 - Dashuri Bardhezi
programme.desc: Abidini dhe Gylsymi u japin lajmin e martesës familjarëve të tyre. Si do ta presin ata? Ferhati dhe Asllëja shkojnë tek shtëpia prej guri. Pas një debati të fortë, të dy ata bien pre e dashurisë. Jeteri dhe Idili përballen me njëra-tjetrën. Çfarë plani ka në mendje kjo e fundit?

programme.title: Kad lišće pada
programme.desc: Pas dorëheqjes së Ali Rizait dhe pranimit të Nexhlës në universitet, familja Tekin zhvendoset në Stamboll për një jetë të re. Mes vështirësive të përshtatjes dhe sfidave të qytetit të madh, Ali Rizai përpiqet ta mbajë familjen të bashkuar dhe të ruajë vlerat e ndershmërisë që e kanë udhëhequr gjithë jetën.

programme.title: Pitanje časti
programme.desc: Pasi djalit të vogël të shtëpisë, Emirit, i fillon stazhi në Stamboll, Zelihaja fillon planet për tu larguar. Por si do të reagojë vjehrri i saj kur ta marrë vesh këtë? Ajo e bind Hasanin të largohen, duke lënë çdo gjë pas dhe nisen drejt Stambollit. I afërmi i Zelihasë do t’i ndihmojë të ngrenë biznesin e tyre. Çfarë i premton Jiti të ëmës në ditën e tyre të parë në shtëpinë e re?

programme.title: Вътрешен човек – драма, трилър, биографичен. Въздействащ трилър, заснет по действителен случай. Филмът проследява историята на един обикновен човек, изправен срещу големите корпорации и огромните печалби на тютюневата индустрия.

От местопрестъплението: Маями – сериал, сезон 7 . Сериалът проследява работата на екип от криминолози в Маями, които разкриват на пръв поглед неразгадаеми престъпления с помощта на зашеметяващи научни методи.

От местопрестъплението: Маями – сериал, сезон 7. Сериалът проследява работата на екип от криминолози в Маями, които разкриват на пръв поглед неразгадаеми престъпления с помощта на зашеметяващи научни методи.

Дилъри на време – екшън, фантастика, трилър. В съвсем близко бъдеще, времето вече съвсем буквално е равносилно на пари. Хората спират да стареят на 25 години, но единственият начин да останат живи е да спечелят, вземат назаем, откраднат или наследят повече време.

Най-мрачният час – исторически, военен, биографичен . Новоназначеният британски министър-председател Уинстън Чърчил е изправен пред тежък избор – да преговаря с Хитлер или да воюва с него. През следващите четири седмици на 1940 г. Чърчил затвърждава своето наследство със смелите си решения и лидерски качества.

Френският бюлетин на либърти, Канзас Ивнинг Сън – драма, комедия, романтика . След смъртта на редактора на Френския бюлетин на либърти, екипът му се събира, за да напише некролога му, което води до създаването на четири истории: пътепис за мръсните квартали на града, история за престъпник и луд художник, и неговата муза-затворничка, хроника на любовта и смъртта в разгара на един студентски бунт и разказ за наркотици, отвличане и изискана кухня.
В кадър. Поредица, представяща различни холивудски звезди и техните успехи в областта на киното.

От местопрестъплението: Маями – сериал, сезон 7 . Сериалът проследява работата на екип от криминолози в Маями, които разкриват на пръв поглед неразгадаеми престъпления с помощта на зашеметяващи научни методи.

Комисар Рекс – сериал, сезон 1. Рекс е добре обучено полицейско куче, което може да открива наркотици, да проследява контрабандни стоки и да разкрива различни престъпления. Наред със своите уникални способности, той може и да разсмива околните – в моментите, в които се опитва да открадне малко храна или да направи някой номер.

Коледно преследване – комедия, криминален, романтика . Полицейският детектив Таня си партнира със своя колега Райън, за да разрешат поредица от обири. Те влизат под прикритие като младоженци, премествайки се в празната къща до г-н Милър, главният заподозрян по случая.
Любовен дизайн – романтика. Лиза се завръща в родния си град, за да потърси вдъхновение за новата си модна колекция, но се влюбва в писателя, на когото е възложено да редактира автобиографията й.

Убийствен развод – драма, трилър. Бившият съпруг на Джоузи, Майкъл, влиза в цветарския й магазин с бизнес предложение, което тя не може да откаже. Това я въвлича в семейната драма между Майкъл и обявената му за луда съпруга.

Пристигане в Америка – комедия, романтика . Еди Мърфи е много богат и разглезен африкански принц, който пристига в Америка в търсене на съпруга. Съпровождан от най-високопоставения си приближен (Арсенио Хол), той бързо си намира работа, нови приятели, нови врагове и не малко проблеми.

Шпионски бъркотии – анимация, екшън, комедия. Супершпионинът Ланс Стърлинг и ученият Уолтър Бекет са си взаимно полезни - Уолтър създава страхотни технологии, които Ланс използва за епичните си мисии. Липсата на екипност в работата им обаче е заплаха за глобалната сигурност...

От местопрестъплението: Маями – сериал, сезон 7 . Сериалът проследява работата на екип от криминолози в Маями, които разкриват на пръв поглед неразгадаеми престъпления с помощта на зашеметяващи научни методи.

От местопрестъплението: Маями – сериал, сезон 7. Сериалът проследява работата на екип от криминолози в Маями, които разкриват на пръв поглед неразгадаеми престъпления с помощта на зашеметяващи научни методи.

Таткова градина – комедия, семеен. Чарли и Фил губят работата си и трябва да станат бащи, които си стоят вкъщи. Това ги вдъхновява да открият собствен дневен център, който след поредица от забавни ситуации им помага да си припомнят радостите на бащинството.

Омразата, която сееш – драма, криминален. Стар Картър живее в два паралелни свята. Бедният, населен предимно с чернокожи квартал, където живее и училището, което посещават предимно бели. Нелесният баланс между тези две реалности е нарушен, когато Стар вижда полицай да застрелва най-добрият й приятел от детството Калил.

Джентълменска кръв – екшън, комедия, криминален . Мери и Бен са черните овце на две могъщи фамилии, които са във вековна вражда. Те са разделени от години, но са на път да подновят аферата си. Тяхната забранена любов ще доведе до съдбоносни събития.
В кадър. Поредица, представяща различни холивудски звезди и техните успехи в областта на киното.

От местопрестъплението: Маями – сериал, сезон 7 . Сериалът проследява работата на екип от криминолози в Маями, които разкриват на пръв поглед неразгадаеми престъпления с помощта на зашеметяващи научни методи.

Комисар Рекс – сериал, сезон 1. Рекс е добре обучено полицейско куче, което може да открива наркотици, да проследява контрабандни стоки и да разкрива различни престъпления. Наред със своите уникални способности, той може и да разсмива околните – в моментите, в които се опитва да открадне малко храна или да направи някой номер.
Любовен дизайн – романтика . Лиза се завръща в родния си град, за да потърси вдъхновение за новата си модна колекция, но се влюбва в писателя, на когото е възложено да редактира автобиографията й.

Модерна любов – романтика. Ейвъри таи тайна мечта да стане моден дизайнер и да работи за конкретна известна модна къща. Оливър, известен плейбой, й предлага възможност да работи за любимия й бранд, а в замяна на това да излиза публично с него, за да се измие образа му на „лошо момче“.

Смърт пред олтара – трилър. Малори е смазана от факта, че годеникът умира в деня на сватбата им. Докладът от аутопсията показва нечиста игра, а след убийството на друг неин близък, младата жена се досеща, че е следващата жертва на мистериозен убиец.

Терминатор: Генисис – екшън, трилър, фантастика . Годината е 2029. Джон Конър е водач на съпротивата срещу машините. Скоро агентите на ТЕКОМ разкриват нов заговор на СкайНет да го атакуват на два фронта – миналото и бъдещето. Ход, който ще промени войната завинаги.

Дилъри на време – екшън, фантастика, трилър . В съвсем близко бъдеще, времето вече съвсем буквално е равносилно на пари. Хората спират да стареят на 25 години, но единственият начин да останат живи е да спечелят, вземат назаем, откраднат или наследят повече време.

Опасна клопка – екшън, трилър. Бивш морски тюлен и настоящ портиер в луксозена жилищна сграда в Ню Йорк трябва да надхитри и да пребори група от крадци на произведения на изкуството, докато в същото време се опитва да защити семейството на дъщеря си.

programme.title: LEGO Ninjago: Masters of Spinjitzu

programme.title: LEGO Ninjago: Masters of Spinjitzu

programme.desc: Le désert d'Arabie est une des régions les plus hostile sur terre. C'est une fournaise, une étendue aride où la pluie ne tombe pratiquement jamais, obligeant les animaux à vivre sous une chaleur torride. Chacun d'eux est paré pour les conditions extrêmes. programme.desc: La nouvelle de la mort de Matthew émeut tout le village, qui vient soutenir Marilla et Anne. Après les funérailles, Marilla confie à Anne qu'elle avait autrefois eu une romance avec le père de Gilbert.

programme.title: L'école des champions
programme.desc: Tout juste arrivé dans un village italien, le jeune Benjamin n'a qu'une idée en tête : intégrer le club de football le plus proche afin d'assouvir sa passion.

programme.title: L'école des champions
programme.desc: Pour la finale de la coupe du monde junior, Mario, le capitaine de San Podesta, recrute un jeune buteur, Renato. Celui-ci inquiète beaucoup les joueurs des Ailes de Jupiter...

programme.title: Il était une fois... la vie
programme.desc: La peau est un tissu souple élastique, fait de différentes couches de cellules. Elle constitue l'enveloppe externe de notre organisme...

programme.title: Il était une fois... la vie
programme.desc: Pierrot et Pierrette dégustent un sandwich. Ils font découvrir le travail de la bouche et des dents, qui restent toujours vulnérables aux caries.

programme.title: Jayce et les conquérants de la lumière
programme.desc: Avec l'aide d'un groupe de femmes pirates dirigé par Morgana, Diskor tend un piège à la Force Lumière afin de prendre possession du vaisseau.

programme.title: Dofus : aux trésors de Kerubim
programme.desc: Ce matin-là, sur un simple "bonjour", Simone écope d'une belle volée de bois vert. Même Luis et Joris s'y mettent ! Sans le savoir, la pauvre Simone a tout simplement été victime du Tulamour. Mais qu'est-ce donc ? Une maladie ? Un rhume étrange ? Pas du tout ! Le Tulamour est un objet magique particulièrement difficile à manier.

programme.title: Saint Seiya Omega : Les nouveaux chevaliers du zodiaque
programme.desc: Les élèves rivalisent pour gagner le droit de participer au tournoi : seuls les premiers arrivés au sommet du mont Delta avant l'aube seront retenus.

programme.title: Saint Seiya Omega : Les nouveaux chevaliers du zodiaque
programme.desc: Le tournoi des chevaliers commence. Koga peine à vaincre Hook, chevalier du Compas. Mais il finit par se qualifier, tout comme Yuna, Ryuho et Soma.

programme.title: Détective Conan
programme.desc: Le cadavre de Hamano a été retrouvé dans l'arrière-cour, allongé dans la neige. L'absence de traces de pas tout autour laisse croire qu'un crime impossible vient d'être commis au châlet.

programme.title: Détective Conan
programme.desc: Conan et ses amis visitent un salon de beauté lorsqu'ils assistent à une violente dispute entre Midori, le propriétaire, et l'esthéticienne Mika. Le lendemain, Mika est retrouvée morte.

programme.title: Fairy Tail
programme.desc: Grâce à la flamme de Jellal, Natsu libère entièrement son pouvoir de chasseur de dragon. Chacun se prépare devant les six lacrimas jusqu'au moment fatidique.

programme.title: Fairy Tail
programme.desc: Jellal est remis aux mains du conseil. Natsu et ses amis se rendent à Cait Shelter, où le maître de guilde, Lawbawl, leur dévoile la vérité sur les origines de sa guilde.

programme.title: Nicky Larson
programme.desc: Alors qu'elle fait du shopping, Laura rencontre une amie du lycée. Propriétaire d'une boutique de vêtements, elle convainc Laura de changer de style vestimentaire.

programme.title: Nicky Larson
programme.desc: Hélène se voit confier une nouvelle mission par son supérieur. Un des principaux chefs de la mafia de Hong Kong se cache à Tokyo. Elle demande à Nicky de l'aider sur cette affaire.

programme.title: Saint Seiya : Hadès Inferno
programme.desc: Les douze chevaliers d'Or sont réunis par miracle un bref instant devant le Mur des Lamentations. Ils sont prêts à se sacrifier pour ouvrir une brèche qui permettra aux chevaliers de Bronze de se rendre en Elysion, où sommeille la véritable enveloppe charnelle d'Hadès...

programme.title: Sailor Moon *1992
programme.desc: Bunny rencontre un musicien et l'aide à récupérer une cassette où il a ebregistré des morceaux pour la femme qu'il aime...

programme.title: Sailor Moon *1992
programme.desc: Pour puiser l'énergie des amies de Bunny, Jedyte organise une audition. Toutes les filles y participent dans l'espoir de devenir une grande vedette...

programme.title: Sailor Moon *1992
programme.desc: La reine Perila ordonne à Jedyte de puiser l'énergie chez les élèves de seconde. En même temps, une nouvelle venue intrigue Luna...

programme.title: Sailor Moon *1992
programme.desc: Pour pouvoir récupérer de l'énergie, les monstres font perdre aux humains la notion du temps...

programme.title: Sailor Moon *1992
programme.desc: Plusieurs autobus disparaissent mystérieusement avec tous leurs passagers. Sailor Moon et Luna mènent l'enquête et n'arriveront à résoudre ce problème qu'avec l'aide de Sailor Mercury et la troisième guerrière Sailor Mars...

Capturé par un clan hostile, RAHAN s'échappe en volant un précieux coutelas d'ivoire. Le voici armé pour partir seul exaucer le rêve de CRAO : découvrir la tanière du soleil à l'autre bout de l'horizon.

programme.title: 誰是兇手 第7集
programme.desc: 《誰是兇手》講述了一起發生在海舟市的連環兇案，在真相塵封了十七年之後，與這宗懸案有著千絲萬縷聯繫的人們，在各自不可告人的秘密中，一起等待真相浮出水面的故事。 2001年寒冬，海舟市印刷廠家屬院發生了一起命案。新人刑警冷小兵和師兄接到一起報案奔赴現場，卻意外面對海舟市連環殺人案的兇手。冷小兵膽怯不敢開槍，兇手從現場逃走並殺害了師兄李嵐。現場另一名目擊證人是躲在床下的夏木。為繼續留在警隊冷小兵隱瞞了不敢開槍的事，夏木也沒有揭穿他。至此兇手藏匿起來，海舟案懸而未決。十七年後，夏木來到警隊實習，以冷小兵不敢開槍的事作為把柄，要挾他和自己一起查案。而伴随着神秘的心理医生沈雨的出现，一起几乎与十七年前一模一样的案子再次发生，而沈雨身上一个又一个疑团频频出现，凶手究竟是谁？

programme.title: 監所男子囚生記 第2集

programme.title: 問心 2 第24集
programme.desc: 兩年後，周筱風援黔歸來，被破格提拔為東立醫院史上最年輕的心內科執行主任，他與林逸、方筱然重組“三人小分隊”，在全新的職業挑戰與情感考驗中並肩作戰，面對理想與現實的衝突，繼續堅守信念“問心無愧”。

programme.title: 誰是兇手 第8集
programme.desc: 《誰是兇手》講述了一起發生在海舟市的連環兇案，在真相塵封了十七年之後，與這宗懸案有著千絲萬縷聯繫的人們，在各自不可告人的秘密中，一起等待真相浮出水面的故事。 2001年寒冬，海舟市印刷廠家屬院發生了一起命案。新人刑警冷小兵和師兄接到一起報案奔赴現場，卻意外面對海舟市連環殺人案的兇手。冷小兵膽怯不敢開槍，兇手從現場逃走並殺害了師兄李嵐。現場另一名目擊證人是躲在床下的夏木。為繼續留在警隊冷小兵隱瞞了不敢開槍的事，夏木也沒有揭穿他。至此兇手藏匿起來，海舟案懸而未決。十七年後，夏木來到警隊實習，以冷小兵不敢開槍的事作為把柄，要挾他和自己一起查案。而伴随着神秘的心理医生沈雨的出现，一起几乎与十七年前一模一样的案子再次发生，而沈雨身上一个又一个疑团频频出现，凶手究竟是谁？

programme.title: 監所男子囚生記 第3集
programme.desc: 一個厭世新鮮人意外進入監獄成為管理員，同時監獄也有一群迫不得已在此工作的夥伴，每天面臨各種光怪陸離的遭遇。

programme.title: 問心 2 第25集
programme.desc: 兩年後，周筱風援黔歸來，被破格提拔為東立醫院史上最年輕的心內科執行主任，他與林逸、方筱然重組“三人小分隊”，在全新的職業挑戰與情感考驗中並肩作戰，面對理想與現實的衝突，繼續堅守信念“問心無愧”。

programme.title: 誰是兇手 第7集
programme.desc: 《誰是兇手》講述了一起發生在海舟市的連環兇案，在真相塵封了十七年之後，與這宗懸案有著千絲萬縷聯繫的人們，在各自不可告人的秘密中，一起等待真相浮出水面的故事。 2001年寒冬，海舟市印刷廠家屬院發生了一起命案。新人刑警冷小兵和師兄接到一起報案奔赴現場，卻意外面對海舟市連環殺人案的兇手。冷小兵膽怯不敢開槍，兇手從現場逃走並殺害了師兄李嵐。現場另一名目擊證人是躲在床下的夏木。為繼續留在警隊冷小兵隱瞞了不敢開槍的事，夏木也沒有揭穿他。至此兇手藏匿起來，海舟案懸而未決。十七年後，夏木來到警隊實習，以冷小兵不敢開槍的事作為把柄，要挾他和自己一起查案。而伴随着神秘的心理医生沈雨的出现，一起几乎与十七年前一模一样的案子再次发生，而沈雨身上一个又一个疑团频频出现，凶手究竟是谁？

programme.title: 監所男子囚生記 第2集
programme.desc: 一個厭世新鮮人意外進入監獄成為管理員，同時監獄也有一群迫不得已在此工作的夥伴，每天面臨各種光怪陸離的遭遇。

programme.title: 問心 2 第24集
programme.desc: 兩年後，周筱風援黔歸來，被破格提拔為東立醫院史上最年輕的心內科執行主任，他與林逸、方筱然重組“三人小分隊”，在全新的職業挑戰與情感考驗中並肩作戰，面對理想與現實的衝突，繼續堅守信念“問心無愧”。

programme.title: 誰是兇手 第8集
programme.desc: 《誰是兇手》講述了一起發生在海舟市的連環兇案，在真相塵封了十七年之後，與這宗懸案有著千絲萬縷聯繫的人們，在各自不可告人的秘密中，一起等待真相浮出水面的故事。 2001年寒冬，海舟市印刷廠家屬院發生了一起命案。新人刑警冷小兵和師兄接到一起報案奔赴現場，卻意外面對海舟市連環殺人案的兇手。冷小兵膽怯不敢開槍，兇手從現場逃走並殺害了師兄李嵐。現場另一名目擊證人是躲在床下的夏木。為繼續留在警隊冷小兵隱瞞了不敢開槍的事，夏木也沒有揭穿他。至此兇手藏匿起來，海舟案懸而未決。十七年後，夏木來到警隊實習，以冷小兵不敢開槍的事作為把柄，要挾他和自己一起查案。而伴随着神秘的心理医生沈雨的出现，一起几乎与十七年前一模一样的案子再次发生，而沈雨身上一个又一个疑团频频出现，凶手究竟是谁？

programme.title: 監所男子囚生記 第3集
programme.desc: 一個厭世新鮮人意外進入監獄成為管理員，同時監獄也有一群迫不得已在此工作的夥伴，每天面臨各種光怪陸離的遭遇。

programme.title: 問心 2 第25集
programme.desc: 兩年後，周筱風援黔歸來，被破格提拔為東立醫院史上最年輕的心內科執行主任，他與林逸、方筱然重組“三人小分隊”，在全新的職業挑戰與情感考驗中並肩作戰，面對理想與現實的衝突，繼續堅守信念“問心無愧”。

programme.title: Wylde Pak
programme.desc: Jack, 13 ans, mène une vie d'aventurier avec sa mère jusqu'à ce que celle-ci décide de le confier à son père et à sa belle-mère le temps de l'été. Le couple vit à Canyon Valley où il est à la tête d'un salon de toilettage. A cette occasion, le garçon retrouve Lily, sa demi-soeur de 11 ans, et sa grand-mère. Pendant ces quelques semaines, Jack et Lily, qui n'ont rien en commun, vont se redécouvrir.

programme.title: Sonic Prime

Një aloritëm I dashurisë përdoret për të llogaritur dhe gjetur përshtatjen perfekte duke përdorur një proces që përfshinë intervista të detajizuara, pyetësor dhe teste të përshtatjes. Ato të dhëna përdoren për të identifikuar ciftet perfekte mes pjesëmarrësve. Por rezultatet mbahen të fshehura prej tyre për ti lejuar ata të njoftohen dhe të kalojnë teste javore për të zgjedhur partnerët e tyre ideal teksa bashkëjetojnë. Nëse personi të cilin zgjedhin nuk përputhet me të dhënat, ata duhet të fillojnë kërkimin e tyre nga e para. Nëse zgjedhin atë që është parazgjedhur për ta atëherë ndajnë cmimin më të madh të dhënë ndonjëherë nga një emision i MTV-së dhe largohen me një partner potencial.

programme.title: Handball: Testspiel
programme.desc: Deutschland — Frankreich in Stuttgart. Bevor am 3. Dezember die EM beginnt, steht die Neuauflage des WM-Halbfinals auf dem Programm. Die DHB-Auswahl setzte sich gegen den dreimaligen Weltmeister sensationell mit 29:23 durch, wobei Antje Döll (38) neun Treffer erzielte.

programme.title: Family Guy
programme.desc: Anlässlich ihres Geburtstages bekommt Lois von Brian Kreuzfahrttickets geschenkt. Zusammen mit Peter löst Lois die Karten ein. Ganz zur Enttäuschung von Stewie, der wieder zurückgelassen wird und nun Rache will. Er mietet sich kurzerhand ein Motorboot und erschießt Lois auf dem Kreuzfahrtschiff...

programme.title: Family Guy
programme.desc: Stewie ist überrascht, als Lois vor ihm steht. Er glaubte eigentlich, sie erschossen zu haben. Lois hetzt ihm die CIA auf den Hals – ein Katz-und-Maus Spiel beginnt.

programme.title: Quante storie

programme.title: Generazione Bellezza
programme.desc: Generazione Bellezza prova a chiarire la complessa evoluzione del patrimonio culturale, il quale viene chiesto sempre più di essere vero e proprio apparato "produttore di cultura", non più elemento statico. A musei e luoghi di cultura, di conseguenza, la richiesta è quella di essere elementi vivi e vitali delle città, ponti di connessione e trasmissione, ma anche di creazione e formazione del sape

programme.title: Un posto al sole
programme.desc: Soap italien racontant le quotidien des habitants du prestigieux Palazzo di Palladini, ancienne propriété de l'aristocrate Napolitain Giacomo Palladini, qui surplombe le Golf de Naples et le Vésuve. A sa mort, le compte Palladini lègue l'appartement le plus prestigieux, appelé "La terrazza" en raison de sa vue imprenable, à sa dernière fille naturelle, Anna Boschi, qu'il a eue avec la gouvernante.

programme.title: Chi l'ha visto?

programme.title: Rainbow Ruby

programme.title: Rainbow Ruby

programme.title: RiffTrax Live: "Manos" the Hands of Fate
programme.desc: This is a completely new riff of “Manos” The Hands of Fate, the Texas-fertilizer-salesman-directed classic made famous by Mystery Science Theater 3000.

programme.title: RiffTrax: Astro Zombies
programme.desc: Reuniting Tom “The Kid” Pace with his Girl in Gold Boots director Ted V. Mikels, Astro-Zombies are neither zombies nor the dog from The Jetsons. The film also stars John Carradine, who aged approximately 92 years in the 28 years.

programme.title: RiffTrax: Day of the Shorts SF Sketchfest 2019
programme.desc: Live from SF Sketchfest, it's Day of the Shorts: Sketchfest 2019! This feature is a parody and contains the original shorts combined with a comedic commentary by Mike, Kevin and Bill from RiffTrax (formerly of MST3K) and other comedy guests.

programme.title: RiffTrax: Beast Of The Yellow Night
programme.desc: RiffTrax, the guys who make movies funny, bring their comedic riffing treatment to this cheesy horror classic! Go mad trying to figure out what is happening in Beast of the Yellow Night!

programme.title: RiffTrax: The Visitor
programme.desc: A baffling mess, as incoherent as it is unintentionally funny. This feature is a parody and contains the original movie combined with a comedic commentary by Mike, Kevin and Bill from RiffTrax (formerly of Mystery Science Theater 3000).

programme.title: RiffTrax Short: How Much Affection?
programme.desc: It's a question we ponder every time we tip the pizza guy: How much affection? Is it necessary to set the box down before embracing him?

programme.title: RiffTrax Live: Samurai Cop
programme.desc: RiffTrax takes on one of the most loved Z-grade action films of the early 90s: Samurai Cop. The cop they call Samurai takes himself and his fabulous hair (really, it is an amazing thing to behold) to Los Angeles from a faraway land they call San Diego.

programme.title: RiffTrax: The Night That Dracula Saved The World
programme.sub-title: The Night That Dracula Saved The World
programme.desc: While The Night that Dracula Saved the World does not have Harvey Korman, or crappy animation, or an elderly wookie pleasuring itself, it does have Judd Hirsch. Please do not go into this special expecting not to see Judd Hirsch. Fair warning.

programme.title: RiffTrax Shorts: Glasses for Susan
programme.desc: Susan needs glasses. Not like, “Oh, it's hard for her to read a small font.” No, Susan appears to be legally blind. Somehow she has made it to eight without wandering in front of a truck. This short is a parody and contains a comedic commentary.

programme.title: RiffTrax Shorts: At Your Fingertips: Floats (Live Edition)
programme.desc: This short instructs how to build a general TYPE of garbage-craft, a floating garbage craft, rather than focusing on utilizing a specific type of garbage to build a craft. This short is a parody and contains a comedic commentary by RiffTrax.

programme.title: RiffTrax Short: Your Chance To Live
programme.desc: What happens when a public television studio realizes that it has to spend $2,000 of government grant money before Wednesday in order to qualify for full funding for the next fiscal year? You get Your Chance to Live: Technological Failures!

programme.title: Best of RiffTrax: Villains
programme.desc: For this Best of, we wanted to focus on some of the more overlooked villains in our catalogue. Though they may not be iconic, these nefarious scoundrels' deeds are no less evil, their laughter is no less insane, and their ponytails are no less greasy.

programme.title: Rifftrax Shorts: Measuring Man
programme.desc: From the stars of Mystery Science Theater 3000 comes the comedic genius known as Rifftrax!

programme.title: RiffTrax: Martial Law
programme.desc: Steve McQueen's son Chad stars as Sean Thompson, who has achieved a high rank on the police force despite having the raw charisma of a collectible spoon. This parody contains the original movie combined with a comedic commentary from RiffTrax.

programme.title: RiffTrax: Zombie I Eat Your Skin
programme.desc: A more accurate title would have been I Occasionally Chop Off Heads With a Machete Because I'm The Voodoo Kind Of Zombie, Not The BRAAAAINS Kind. This feature is a parody and contains the original movie combined with a comedic commentary from RiffTrax.

programme.title: Caban Jam Gareth

programme.title: Ger a Gu

programme.title: Parc Glan Gwil

programme.title: Caru Canu

programme.title: Yr Whws

programme.title: Non élucidé

programme.title: Non élucidé

L'autopsie révèle qu'elle a été battue à mort et qu'elle n'a pas subi de violences sexuelles. Début 2014, son assassinat demeure non élucidé.

programme.title: Non élucidé
programme.desc: Le 2 novembre 2001, Eric Calers est raccompagné chez lui à Busnes, dans le Pas-de-Calais, par un collègue après sa journée de travail. programme.title: Non élucidé

Depuis 2010, une information pour chantage, vol, assassinat est ouverte par le parquet de Béthune. Mais, pour l'instant, le mystère reste entier.

programme.title: Non élucidé

Quelques minutes plus tard, deux hommes cagoulés entrent et l'abattent.

programme.title: Non élucidé

programme.title: Apartamenti i pafajësisë
programme.desc: Han një djalosh i pashëm dhe karizmatik është i mbushur me kujtime të dhimbshme dhe tragjedi brenda familjes. Pas kthimit nga SHBA, ai i kushton jetën babait dhe motrave të cilat vuajnë nga probleme fiziologjike, si pasojë tragjike e traumave të tyre të fëmijërisë dhe historisë familjare. I izoluar nga çdo aktivitet shoqëror rastesisht takon Incin dhe menjëherë bie në dashuri me të. Për herë të parë në jetën e tij, do të kërkojë lumturinë!

programme.title: Shaktar Donetsk - Fenerbahçe - UEFA Şampiyonlar Ligi Grup Maçları
programme.desc: Liga e Kampionëve është kompeticioni kryesor vjetor i UEFA-s për klubet e futbollit, që bashkon ekipet më të mira nga ligat kombëtare të Evropës. E themeluar në vitin 1955 si Kupa e Klubeve Kampione të Evropës dhe e riemërtuar në vitin 1992, ajo ka evoluar nga një turne me eliminim të drejtpërdrejtë në një fazë lige me 36 skuadra, të pasuar nga raunde me eliminim të drejtpërdrejtë dhe një finale me një ndeshje të vetme. Kualifikimi bazohet kryesisht në paraqitjen në ligat kombëtare dhe në koeficientët e federatave anëtare të UEFA-s, ndërsa kompeticioni përfaqëson nivelin më të lartë të futbollit evropian për klube. Fituesi shpallet kampion i Evropës për klube dhe kualifikohet gjithashtu për kompeticione të tjera të rëndësishme të UEFA-s dhe FIFA-s.

programme.desc: Han një djalosh i pashëm dhe karizmatik është i mbushur me kujtime të dhimbshme dhe tragjedi brenda familjes. programme.title: Beşiktaş - Hapoel Beerşeba - UEFA Avrupa Ligi Grup Maçları
programme.desc: Liga e Evropës e UEFA-s është një kompeticion vjetor i futbollit për klube, i organizuar që nga viti 1971 nga UEFA për klubet evropiane të kualifikueshme. Është kompeticioni i nivelit të dytë i futbollit evropian për klube, duke u renditur poshtë Ligës së Kampionëve të UEFA-s dhe mbi Ligën e Konferencës të UEFA-s. I prezantuar në vitin 1971 si Kupa UEFA, ai zëvendësoi Kupën e Panaireve Ndërqytetëse. Kompeticioni mori emrin e tij aktual në vitin 2009, pas një ndryshimi të formatit që përfshinte një bashkim me Kupën Intertoto të UEFA-s, duke zgjeruar fazën e grupeve dhe duke ndryshuar kualifikimin. Në sezonin 2024–25, faza e grupeve u zëvendësua nga një fazë lige me 36 ekipe. Fituesit e Ligës së Evropës të UEFA-s kualifikohen për Superkupën e UEFA-s dhe Ligën e Kampionëve të UEFA-s të sezonit pasardhës.

programme.title: ÇSKA Sofya - Trabzonspor - UEFA Konferans Ligi Grup Maçları
programme.desc: Liga e Konferencës e UEFA-s është një kompeticion ndërkombëtar i përvitshëm futbolli për klube meshkujsh, i organizuar nga UEFA, që përbën nivelin e tretë të futbollit evropian për klube, pas Ligës së Kampionëve dhe Ligës së Evropës të UEFA-s. I themeluar në vitin 2021, turneu mbledh klube nga e gjithë Evropa që garojnë për një trofe të rëndësishëm kontinental. Kompeticioni përfshin raunde kualifikuese, të ndjekura nga një fazë lige me 36 skuadra, ku secili klub luan gjashtë ndeshje kundër kundërshtarëve të ndryshëm, përpara se të kalohet në ndeshjet e fazës play-off dhe raundet me eliminim të drejtpërdrejtë. Turneu kulmon me një finale të vetme që përcakton kampionin, i cili siguron gjithashtu kualifikimin në Ligën e Evropës të UEFA-s për sezonin pasardhës.

programme.title: 健康2.0 / All About Health
programme.desc: 您对自己的身体了解多少？怎么样吃才能吃出健康和美丽？网络上的健康秘方到底是真是假？主持人郑凯云、江坤俊医师与韦汝将为您的健康把关！.

programme.title: 女人我最大 / Queen
programme.desc: 《女人我最大》节目内容包罗万象，从各行各业的奇特文化；社会异象到生活新鲜事，美艳的主持人蓝心湄将带领观众一起探讨及解开谜团。.

programme.title: 地球黄金线 / Global Golden Line
programme.desc: 「地球黄金线」首创专业汽车实境秀，提共最实用的市售车评比、最深入的汽车经典赏析、最夯的车坛趋势，解析汽车科新风貌。.

programme.title: 食尚玩家 / Super Taste
programme.desc: 美食旅游节目「食尚玩家」带你走遍台湾与世界各地，寻找在地美食，体验最道地的旅游行程。.

programme.title: 国民大会 / Citizens' Subjects
programme.desc: 「国民大会」从台湾的人、台湾的事，畅谈台湾的故事，以深入浅出，轻松幽默的不同面向解读社会时事的氛围。.

programme.title: FOCUS全球新闻 / Global Focus
programme.desc: 聚焦全球大事，从华府到北京，从欧美到亚非，从政治、经济到科技与文化，透过深度而完整的报导，带领观众进入关键事件的核心，补给面向世界的知识能量，掌握国际发展趋势。.

Okrasa łamie przepisy
programme.desc: W tym odcinku Karol Okrasa w miejscowości Nowe Radzikowo w pobliżu Czerwińska nad Wisłą spotyka się z paniami z Koła Gospodyń Wiejskich, które odtwarzają dawne przepisy. Jedną z takich ciekawych potraw są placki z buraka cukrowego.

programme.title: Polacy na ratunek Żydom
programme.desc: W tym odcinku Irena Karczewska z domu Weisberg opowiada historię swojej rodziny, jej losów w trakcie wojny i osób, które pomogły jej w tym trudnym czasie.

programme.title: Stulecie Winnych
programme.desc: Jasiek jest przetrzymywany w areszcie. Władek i Kazia są bezsilni. Wiedzą, że Łucja widziała całe zdarzenie, ale milczy. Proszą o pomoc Bronię. Babka Winna żąda, by dziewczyna powiedziała policji prawdę. Posuwa się do groźby.

programme.title: Stawka większa niż życie
programme.desc: Do Berlina wyrusza łączniczka podziemnej organizacji z bardzo ważnymi informacjami. Ma je przekazać agentce - szwedzkiej aktorce Christin Kield. W rzeczywistości Christin jest agentką podwójną.

programme.title: Vito odkrywa Polskę
programme.desc: Tym razem Vito odwiedził pradawną krainę, czyli Jurę Krakowsko - Częstochowską. Wspinał się na wapienne skały w Rzędkowicach, odwiedził swojego rodaka w pizzerii i dowiedział się, czemu budowano zamki obronne na słynnym szlaku Orlich Gniazd.

programme.title: Barwy szczęścia
programme.desc: Celina kontynuuje działania w sprawie Justina, co spotyka się z wyraźnym niezadowoleniem ze strony Łukasza. Ostatecznie Brońska przekazuje zgromadzone dowody komisarzowi Majakowi, zwracając się do funkcjonariusza z prośbą o interwencję.

programme.title: Dziewczyna ze zdjęcia
programme.desc: W 2022 r. IPN z okazji 8 marca upublicznił kilka zdjęć archiwalnych przedstawiających Polki. Wśród nich uwagę przykuwała fotografia młodej dziewczyny w mundurze wojskowymi i furażerce. To jedno z 40 milionów zdjęć znajdujących się w IPN.

programme.title: Niezwykłe miejsca
programme.desc: Reportaże o charakterze edukacyjnym prezentujące niezwykłe miejsca w Polsce. Miejsca znane i mniej znane, często zapomniane. Prowadzący przenoszą widza do minionych epok, uwzględniając dokonania współczesnych konserwatorów, historyków.

programme.title: Cisza nad rozlewiskiem
programme.desc: Nad rozlewiskiem ogólny smutek, trwają przygotowania do pogrzebu Kaśki. Małgosia jest załamana, a do tego musi zająć się wszystkimi pod nieobecność Basi. Rysio załamany po nieudanych urodzinach postanawia razem z Bronią uciec z domu.

programme.title: Cisza nad rozlewiskiem
programme.desc: Po śmierci Kasi Basia postanawia znowu opuścić rozlewisko. Wyjeżdża do Indii, by odnaleźć duchowy spokój. Krzysztof zdecydował - nie wyjedzie do Szczytna. Postanawia związać życie z Marysią i coraz lepiej czuje się w roli przyszłego ojca.

programme.title: Rozmowy (nie)wygodne
programme.desc: Inspirujące rozmowy Mariusza Szczygła z wybitnymi osobowościami świata kultury i sztuki. Prowokujące pytania, wymagające nieszablonowych odpowiedzi i odkrywania swojej osobowości. Wywiady odbywać się będą we "Wrzenie Świata" - miejscu spotkań bohemy intelektualnej Warszawy. Gość: Joanna Kurowska, aktorka.

programme.title: Wielki test
programme.desc: Czy wiemy, jak bardzo nasze życie zależy od przyrody i jej różnorodności? Bioróżnorodność to nie tylko bogactwo gatunków roślin i zwierząt, ale także nasze zdrowie, żywność, czyste powietrze i bezpieczeństwo przyszłych pokoleń. W Wielkim Teście o Bioróżnorodności sprawdzimy, ile wiemy o świecie natury i jak możemy go chronić. Bo troska o przyrodę to tak naprawdę troska o nas samych.

programme.title: Pan Mama
programme.desc: Patrycja odkrywa, że jej postać w serialu zostanie uśmiercona, a Zuza organizuje internetową kampanię ratunkową. Sylwester unika rozmowy z Mają o stracie mamy, ale w końcu musi się z tym zmierzyć. Patrycja dostaje rolę życia. Czy wyprowadzi się i zniknie z rodziny Dzików?

programme.title: Na dobre i na złe
programme.desc: Do Leśnej Góry trafia młody pacjent po próbie samobójczej, którego ocaliła koleżanka - współlokatorka. A gdy w szpitalu stan chłopaka gwałtownie się pogarsza, o jego życie walczą wspólnie Julka z doktorem Jakubkiem.

programme.title: SeriaLove Wspomnienia
programme.desc: Gośćmi Macieja Kurzajewskiego będą bohaterowie ulubionych produkcji telewizyjnych. Podążymy za historią, przeżyciami i odkryjemy nieznane sceny oraz wspomnienia z serialowych planów. Tym razem Maciej porozmawia z Marcelem Szytenchelmem, odtwórcą kultowej roli Mariana Koniuszki z serialu "Zmiennicy".

programme.title: Rozmowy (nie)wygodne
programme.desc: Inspirujące rozmowy Mariusza Szczygła z wybitnymi osobowościami świata kultury i sztuki. Prowokujące pytania, wymagające nieszablonowych odpowiedzi i odkrywania swojej osobowości. Wywiady odbywać się będą we "Wrzenie Świata" - miejscu spotkań bohemy intelektualnej Warszawy. Gość: Joanna Kurowska, aktorka.

programme.title: Barwy szczęścia
programme.desc: Celina kontynuuje działania w sprawie Justina, co spotyka się z wyraźnym niezadowoleniem ze strony Łukasza. Ostatecznie Brońska przekazuje zgromadzone dowody komisarzowi Majakowi, zwracając się do funkcjonariusza z prośbą o interwencję.

programme.title: Smaki świata po polsku
programme.desc: Ola Nguyen to mistrzyni kuchni, dzieciństwo spędziła w Wietnamie, a nad Wisłę przyjechała w wieku 7 lat. Pomaga jej Robert El Gendy, który urodził się na Mazurach, ale płynie w nim egipska krew. Któż lepiej niż ten duet zgłębi kuchnię?

programme.title: Cisza nad rozlewiskiem
programme.desc: Nad rozlewiskiem ogólny smutek, trwają przygotowania do pogrzebu Kaśki. Małgosia jest załamana, a do tego musi zająć się wszystkimi pod nieobecność Basi. Rysio załamany po nieudanych urodzinach postanawia razem z Bronią uciec z domu.

programme.title: Cisza nad rozlewiskiem
programme.desc: Po śmierci Kasi Basia postanawia znowu opuścić rozlewisko. Wyjeżdża do Indii, by odnaleźć duchowy spokój. Krzysztof zdecydował - nie wyjedzie do Szczytna. Postanawia związać życie z Marysią i coraz lepiej czuje się w roli przyszłego ojca.

programme.title: Bartoszewski. Siła przebaczenia
programme.desc: Film przedstawia życie i dziedzictwo Władysława Bartoszewskiego, historyka, dyplomaty, pisarza i świadka historii, którego życie było świadectwem mocy człowieczeństwa w obliczu tragedii. Narracja ukazuje Bartoszewskiego nie tylko jako świadka historii, ale przede wszystkim jako człowieka, który konsekwentnie odrzucał nienawiść. Film podkreśla, że przebaczenie - choć trudne - było dla niego nie akt

programme.title: Zakochaj się w Polsce
programme.desc: Tomasz Bednarek w swojej podróży po Polsce odwiedza Głuchołazy, miasto tuż obok czeskiej granicy, z niezwykłą Parkową Górą i tężnią solankową. Głuchołazy szczycą się też bogatą historią wydobycia złota. Do miasta zjeżdżają rowerzyści.

programme.title: Barwy szczęścia
programme.desc: Podczas wizyty Huberta w szpitalu Adam wysuwa pod adresem rodziny Pyrków oskarżenia o zlecenie ataku i domaga się korzyści majątkowej w zamian za milczenie. Informacja o radykalnych działaniach Daniela wywołuje u Asi głęboki wstrząs.

programme.title: Tańcząca ze światem
programme.desc: Program lifestylowo-podróżniczy, w którym prowadząca, Edyta Herbuś, pokazuje życie mieszkańców innych krajów, ich tradycje, kulturę, obyczaje oraz lokalne tańce. Edyta Herbuś odkryje przed widzami uroki i tajemnice Jordanii.

programme.title: Niezwykłe miejsca
programme.desc: Krótkie reportaże o charakterze edukacyjnym prezentujące niezwykłe miejsca w Polsce. Miejsca skrywające wiele tajemnic, owiane legendą, miejsca o bogatej historii. W tym odcinku: Osiedle Boernerowo.

programme.title: Ranczo
programme.desc: Do Wilkowyj dociera jedna z plag współczesnego świata - mafia. Konkretnie dociera dwoma czarnymi bmw, pełnymi ubranych w dresy młodzieńców o byczych karkach. Wilkowyjskie centra biznesu padają ofiarą brutalnego szantażu.

programme.title: Ekstradycja
programme.desc: W Ośrodku Integracji Europejskiej odbywa się tajne spotkanie ministra z zagranicznymi partnerami. Uczestniczy w nim Fiduk. Halski z Wojtkiem umieszczają podsłuch w sali obrad. Następnego dnia Wojtek znika w tajemniczych okolicznościach, a wraz z nim - taśma z nagraniem poufnej konferencji.

programme.title: Sterk - znaczy silny
programme.desc: Film dokumentalny o Polakach mieszkających w Norwegii. Jego celem jest przedstawienie doświadczeń i trudów emigracji na podstawie historii pięciu bohaterów.

programme.title: Waka Huia
programme.desc: For more 35 years, the people of Waimārama have fought to reclaim their reo and revive their marae, training speakers, running Kura Reo, and calling their whānau home. programme.title: Totally Spies
programme.desc: Les jeunes espionnes enquêtent sur une série d'agressions et d'enlèvements à travers le monde. Après une explication avec un robot tyrannique, elles découvrent que les personnes kidnappées sont retenues dans un ancien parc d'attractions désaffecté au Japon...

programme.title: Totally Spies
programme.desc: Une grande cérémonie de mariage bat son plein lorsque la robe de la mariée connaît de "graves dysfonctionnements", et se met à semer la panique partout sur son passage. Jerry met les filles sur le coup : elles ne tardent pas à découvrir qu'il ne s'agit pas d'un cas isolé...

programme.title: Totally Spies
programme.desc: Lorsque le plus grand acteur de comédies romantiques de Hollywood, Rad Smitt, disparaît brutalement, Sam, Clover et Alex sont sous le choc. En se rendant dans la luxueuse propriété de Rad pour chercher des indices, elles découvrent que Rad n'a pas du tout disparu.

programme.title: Totally Spies
programme.desc: Une série de braquages a eu lieu dans plusieurs villes du monde. Jerry envoie les filles enquêter. Elles découvrent que le malfaiteur utilise des gâteaux dont la composition rend docile les personnes qui les mangent...

programme.title: Totally Spies
programme.desc: Alerté que des événements curieux se produisent à Beverly Hills, Jerry y envoie aussitôt Sam, Clover et Alex. Deux héros d'un film, se sont en effet échappés de leur univers de fiction et se battent dans les rues...

programme.title: T'choupi interactif en LSF
programme.desc: Adaptation de la série en langue des signes par le comédien Bachir Saifi, lui-même malentendant, sous forme de vignette incrustée. Idéal pour les enfants qui ne savent pas encore lire.

programme.title: T'choupi interactif en LSF
programme.desc: Papy doit faire les courses pour le gâteau d'anniversaire de son petit fils, avec justement, T'choupi et Fanny. Après la dispute pour savoir lequel des deux s'installera dans le caddie, et une série de farces, Papy est totalement dépassé. T'choupi prend les choses en main et décide de se charger de ses cadeaux...

programme.title: Les aventures de Paddington
programme.desc: Les aventures de Paddington, un jeune ourson péruvien, qui découvre la vie londonienne en compagnie de la famille Brown. Pour lui, le quotidien est toujours surprenant.

But a visit from the ghost of his former business partner Jacob Marley (Leo G. Carroll) and three Christmas spirits (Lionel Braham, Ann Rutherford, D'Arcy Corrigan) might convince him to change his ways and become more kindhearted. This adaptation of the Charles Dickens classic became a holiday staple for decades.

But the love of spirited young suffragette Katherine Ellis (Greer Garson) brings the Latin instructor out of his shell and makes him a beloved campus institution into the 20th century and through the shattering violence of World War I. The film is based on the best-selling novel by James Hilton.

After verifying the claim, the judge urges his friends and neighbors to invest in the land with him. Meanwhile, the judge's teenage son, Andy (Mickey Rooney), falls for a new teacher after getting dumped by his girlfriend. Both the judge and Andy learn that things aren't what they seem.

His mother convinces Tim to try Eton College for six months, but once there he clashes with the traditions of the conservative students -- who are led by Roger's son, school head boy Peter (Freddie Bartholomew). When Tim's girlfriend shows an interest in Peter, Tim's response nearly causes disaster.

programme.title: National Velvet

Aided by former jockey Mi Taylor (Mickey Rooney) and encouraged by her family, the determined Velvet gets her steed, affectionately called "The Pie," ready for the big day. However, a last-minute problem arises with the jockey and an unexpected rider must step in as a replacement.

His subject turns out to be the lovely Eliza Doolittle (Audrey Hepburn), who agrees to speech lessons to improve her job prospects. Higgins and Eliza clash, then form an unlikely bond -- one that is threatened by an aristocratic suitor (Jeremy Brett).

Though she becomes infatuated with the dashing magician, Marcus the Magnificent (Jean-Pierre Aumont), Lili forms a more significant bond with puppeteer Paul (Mel Ferrer) and his four puppets, which she treats as real people. Together, Lili, Paul and the puppets prove to be a popular act, but their success and happiness are threatened by Paul's gruffness.

programme.title: Andy Hardy Meets Debutante
programme.desc: Young Andy Hardy (Mickey Rooney) journeys to New York with his father (Lewis Stone) and close friend Betsy Booth (Judy Garland), where he meets beautiful blonde socialite Daphne (Diana Lewis). Andy immediately forgets about Polly Benedict (Ann Rutherford), his girlfriend back home, and falls head over heels for Daphne. But as he starts to rub elbows with trendy Manhattanites, he begins to long for Polly -- and he soon realizes that the big city lacks the charms of his small hometown.

programme.title: Andy Hardy's Private Secretary
programme.desc: Young Andy Hardy (Mickey Rooney) is in his last year of high school, and final examinations are right around the corner. However, all Andy can think about is participating in school clubs. When his workload simply gets too heavy, he has the bright idea to enlist the attractive Kathryn (Kathryn Grayson) to be his receptionist, which makes his girlfriend, Polly (Ann Rutherford), jealous. Unfortunately, Andy will need both Kathryn and Polly to help him if he is to pass his dreaded English test.

programme.title: Hail the Conquering Hero
programme.desc: Like his war-hero father who was killed in action during World War I, Woodrow Lafayette Pershing Truesmith leaves his small town to join the Marines during World War II. But when he's given a medical discharge after only a month, he takes a job at a San Diego shipyard and writes letters to his mother about his fictitious wartime exploits. When he returns home, he discovers that his innocent lies have spread further than he expected.

programme.title: The Great McGinty
programme.desc: In a dive south of the border, bartender Dan McGinty (Brian Donlevy) stops a young man from committing suicide after a moment of dishonesty, and relates how a moment of honesty brought him down in a flashback. As a young man, McGinty joins a crooked political boss and rises from extortionist to alderman. Urged by the boss to marry his secretary to give respectability to his run for mayor, McGinty agrees -- only to fall in love with his wife and decide to do an honest thing for once in his life.

programme.title: Christmas in July
programme.desc: When the coworkers of Jimmy MacDonald (Dick Powell) play a prank and trick him into thinking that he's won the grand prize money in a slogan contest for a coffee company, he is thrilled and makes plans to marry his sweetheart, Betty Casey (Ellen Drew). To everyone's surprise, the coffee company owner, Dr. Maxford (Raymond Walburn), also falls for the prank and awards the prize check to Jimmy. Eventually the ruse is discovered, jeopardizing Jimmy and Betty's newfound happiness.

programme.title: The Palm Beach Story
programme.desc: This screwball comedy finds married couple Tom (Joel McCrea) and Gerry Jeffers (Claudette Colbert) in a strained relationship, largely due to financial difficulties. Gerry decides to leave Tom, a struggling architect, and head to Palm Beach in order to marry a wealthy man who could fund Tom's projects. When Tom follows Gerry, they cross paths with the quirky millionaire John D. Hackensacker III (Rudy Vallee) and his chatty, husband-seeking sister, Princess Centimillia (Mary Astor).

While they're there, Merlok 2.0 detects something…one of the Magic Books! It's “The Book of Deception.” They go to find it and discover it ended up under a mountain. programme.title: Strawberry Shortcake
programme.desc: All of Berry Bitty City is gathered around to watch the last snowberrykin melt. As the last bit of snow forms a puddle, a cheer goes up, spring is here! It's now time for the annual BerryFest. But with Princess Berrykin out of town on business, who will be the BerryFest Princess and preside over the festival?! Everyone is abuzz with how to go about choosing the Princess and what her duties will be. Postmaster Bee declares the only fair way to go about it is to hold an election. Everyone agrees.

programme.title: Strawberry Shortcake
programme.desc: Strawberry opens her front door to a throng of Berrykins all cheering for the new BerryFest Princess. She is appreciative of their admiration but unsure of exactly what her duties entail. In response the Berrykins bombard her with her duties - major to miniscule. One Berrykin sums it up by telling her she's responsible for presiding over all the activities of the BerryFest to make it the best.

programme.title: Strawberry Shortcake
programme.desc: All of Berry Bitty City is excitedly making their way through the berry batch in search of the elusive Wanderberry. It is to be the dessert at the BerryFest Feast. Everyone is milling about searching for it on their own when Blueberry points out that the rules say the BerryFest Princess is in charge of the search. The girls turn to her for direction and she points them where she thinks the berry might be.

programme.title: Strawberry Shortcake
programme.sub-title: Nothing To Fear But Berries Themselves
programme.desc: Overhearing Blueberry reading a story to the baby Berrykins about the scary Galumphalot, Orange is uncharacteristically shaken. She determines she doesn't want anything scary around her, just relaxation. But while the girls are having a hair-styling party at Lemon's salon, a malfunction at the BerryWorks causes the whole town to go dark. And Orange begins to get really anxious.

programme.title: Strawberry Shortcake
programme.sub-title: Where, Oh, Where Has Our Blueberry Gone?
programme.desc: Blueberry has become obsessed with the mystery book detective heroine, Patti Persimmon. She decorates her store with Patti posters and rearranges her shelves to make room for all the Patti books she's ordered. Blueberry begins to neglect outings with her friends and even goes so far as to dress like her idol just to emulate her. She then starts looking for cases to solve around town.

programme.title: Strawberry Shortcake
programme.desc: While in the midst of a cake decorating demonstration at the café, the girls are uncharacteristically interrupted by an excited Princess Berrykin. She announces the Berrykins have decided to revive the old tradition of the Berry Bitty Buggy Derby. While the girls enthusiastically recount the stories they've heard about it and ask the Princess questions, Blueberry, carrying enough books to block her view, comes through the door and unknowingly interrupts the Princess.

programme.title: Strawberry Shortcake
programme.desc: The grove around Berry Bitty City is abuzz with activity. The Berrykins are using their sparkles to harvest berries, Berrykin Bloom is in his garden spraying flowers with a special solution to make them larger, and Raspberry is nearby gathering flower petals to make perfume. The wind starts to blow and picks up some of the sparkles. The sparkles float along the wind and get combined with some of Berrykin Bloom's solution.

programme.title: Strawberry Shortcake
programme.desc: It's time again for the Dance-Off between the Big Bitty City Dance Team and the Berry Bitty City Dancers. Plum is stressed out and frazzled because she desperately wants to win. And the Big Bitty City Dancers are a force to be reckoned with. They are elegant and beautifully synchronized. Plum shows the girls a maze of dance steps that she's choreographed in the hopes of creating a winning piece. The problem is, the contest is only 1 week away!

programme.title: Strawberry Shortcake
programme.desc: The girls are all gathered at the café. Strawberry is experimenting making applesauce from scratch with a mallet (and making a mess) while the rest busily make their own wrapping paper and bows for the annual gift exchange they hold in celebration of First Frost. Mr. Longface stops by and Strawberry offers him some fresh applesauce but he declines, as he doesn't care for it. He's only there for some tea and, being that he's new in town, doesn't know what the group is up to.

programme.title: Strawberry Shortcake
programme.desc: Raspberry is distraught when she suspects her friends have copied her design on her lantern for the "Glimmerberry Gathering".

programme.title: Strawberry Shortcake
programme.desc: While sipping cider in Strawberry's café, the girls muse about how they cannot wait for winter to arrive. They list the various traditions they love about the season but the one they all agree on is the Glimmerberry Ball. Strawberry mentions that she doesn't think the café can hold the party this year because of how the town has grown. The girls decide to split up and search for a new location.

programme.title: Strawberry Shortcake
programme.desc: Lemon is ecstatic. She races out of her salon and goes around to the other girls' houses proclaiming that she "did it!" and beckoning them to join her. They follow her back and are completely dazzled by her newest creation - Glamicures. They are brightly colored, jeweled manicures with tiny microchips inside that play songs when the wearer moves her hand. Each girl lines up to receive her new glamicure and soon there is a cacophony of color and sound.

programme.title: Strawberry Shortcake
programme.desc: While working in her store, Orange overhears the Berrykins laughing and shouting outside. Just as it floats close, she gives it a bat sending it outside and the Berrykins happily chasing after it. Wanting in on the fun, she joins them.

programme.title: Lynyrd Skynyrd
programme.desc: Earlier this year Lynyrd Skynyrd performed their first two studio albums, “Pronounced ‘Lĕh-'nérd ‘Skin-'nérd” and “Second Helping”, live in their entirety for the first time, at two specially staged concerts at the Florida Theatre in their home town of Jacksonville, Florida. It was a special occasion for both the act and their fans as the band performed tracks they'd never or rarely played live before alongside classic songs that are an essential part of any Lynyrd Skynyrd live show. These unique concerts are a must have for any Lynyrd Skynyrd fan.

programme.title: AC/DC
programme.desc: Filmed at the world famous Circus Krone in Munich, this AC/DC concert from June 17, 2003 features standout performances of "Rock N Roll Damnation" and "What's Next To The Moon" and more.

programme.desc: Get your fill of riff-oriented heavy rock with this dark and moody performance by Queens of the Stone Age. Best enjoyed with the volume turned up high!

programme.title: Philip Catherine, Jean-Louis Rassinfosse & Chet Baker
programme.sub-title: Jazz a la Grand Place Chet Baker Trio
programme.desc: Two top-tier Belgian musicians – guitarist Philip Catherine and bassist Jean-Louis Rassinfosse – accompany American jazz trumpeter and vocalist Chet Baker during this 1985 performance at the beautiful Brussels Jazz Club, located on the Grand-Place, the Belgian capital's central square. The trio plays Charlie Mariano's “Crystal Bells”, the title track of their acclaimed 1983 album. Other songs played during this legendary concert include “Down” and “How Deep is the Ocean”.

programme.title: Avishai Cohen
programme.desc: Double bassist Avishai Cohen's trio with Noam David (drums) and Omri Mor (pianist) joined forces with the international Symphony Orchestra ‘INSO-Lviv', conducted by Christian Schumann. On June 24, 2017 they brought Avishai Cohen's signature blend of influences from Eastern Europe, American jazz and the Middle East to the Alfa Jazz Festival in Lviv, Ukraine. Cohen, who also supplies vocalizations in the Judeo-Spanish dialect Ladino, came to prominence internationally in the 1990s when jazz great Chick Corea offered him a place in his trio and a recording deal. Thirty years later, Cohen has become a house-hold name himself, leaving his Ukrainian audience enthralled and connected through the universal language of music.

programme.title: Art Farmer
programme.desc: An extraordinary collection of clips in all jazz genres from the most beautiful concerts and the most special festivals, performed by the finest jazz musicians.

programme.title: Marcus Miller
programme.desc: This portrait of Marcus Miller was recorded during his 2009 ‘Tutu Revisited' tour. Miller looks back on his relationship with Miles Davis. Miller tells us about writing his composition 'Tutu', and shares countless stories of the recording process of the album 'Tutu'. This documentary was filmed in 2009 at the 'We Want Miles' exhibition in Cité de la Musique in Paris.

programme.title: Thelonious Monk, Charlie Rouse, Ben Riley & Larry Gales
programme.desc: The idiosyncratic pianist and composer Thelonious Monk (1917-1982) is one of the all-time greats of jazz. His music went largely misunderstood for the first 15 years of his career, after which he was rightly hailed as a genius, and received credit as a founding father of bebop. Several concerts from his 1966 European tour were recorded for television, featuring his quartet of Charles Rouse (tenor saxophone), Lawrence Gales (bass) and Benjamin Riley (drums). His quartet performed Epistrophy, 'Round Midnight, and Lulu's Back in Town in Warsaw for Polish television on April 4, 1966. On April 17, the same quartet performed a short set in Copenhagen for Danish television, featuring Lulu's Back in Town, Don't Blame Me, and Epistrophy.

programme.title: Anita Oday, Göran Engdahl, Roman Dylag & John Poole
programme.desc: Anita O'Day boasts two wonderful concerts from 1963 and 1970 that present the “jazz singer supreme” in impeccable form. O'Day's horn-based approach to singing is in full effect throughout both shows including stand-out renditions in each show of audience favorites “Tea For Two” and “Sweet Georgia Brown” (both reprised from her triumphant appearance at the 1958 Newport Jazz Festival.) This show is a fitting testimony to one of jazz music's true originals and shows unequivocally why she is ranked in the top tier of vocalists along with Ella Fitzgerald, Sarah Vaughan, and Billie Holiday.

programme.title: Lalah Hathaway
programme.desc: Winner of five Grammys in four consecutive years, including the Grammy for best R&B album in 2017, Lalah Hathaway is a force impossible to ignore. The American artist has shared the scene with Prince, Snoop Dogg, Stevie Wonder, Anita Baker, Mary J. Blige, Frank Ocean and many others, an irrefutable proof of her keen musical sense and enormous talent. With a 26-year career, Hathaway is still highly sought after by the biggest names in music. See her transform the 2018 Sing Jazz festival scene into a real R&B club, where she flaunts her voice and stage presence out of the ordinary.

programme.title: Jack DeJohnette, Howard Johnson, Greg Osby & John Purcell
programme.sub-title: Jack DeJohnette's Special Edition at Estival 1985
programme.desc: Since 1977, Estival is a summer jazz festival in Switzerland, Lugano. Estival offers a thrilling and particularly surprising line-up that explores the rich world of contemporary music whilst promoting the understanding of different cultures, tolerance, and co-existence. Jack DeJohnette, an important figure in jazz fusion, was inducted into the Modern Drummer Hall of Fame in 2007. His style combines elements of jazz, free jazz, world music and R & B, and his versatility makes him a regarded and in-demand drummer. Discover his unique style as part of this breathtaking performance delivered at Estival.

programme.title: Marion Williams
programme.desc: An extraordinary collection of clips in all jazz genres from the most beautiful concerts and the most special festivals, performed by the finest jazz musicians.

programme.title: Chucho Valdés, Concha Buika, Rodney Barreto & Dreiser Durruthy Bombale
programme.desc: ‘Jazz a Vienne' is one of the world's most prestigious jazz festivals. Ever since 1981 it has attracted leading jazz artists, with many of them playing return engagements. Unsurprisingly, the festival's 2013 edition did not fall short of expectations: the lineup was filled with the biggest names in music. Among them were Chucho Valdes and his Afro-Cuban Messengers, the prime example of Latin-inspired jazz music. Together with vocalists Concha Buika and Dreiser Durruthy Bombale, Rodney Barreto on drums, Gaston Joya on double bass, Yaroldy Abreu Robles on congas, and Reinaldo Melian Alvarez on trumpet, the legendary pianist brings the streets of Havana to the festival's stage.

programme.title: Billie Holiday
programme.desc: “God Bless The Child”, “Foolin' Myself”, and “I Loves You, Porgy”: timeless songs that were made classics by the inimitable Billie Holiday. ‘Lady Day', as her loyal friend and musical partner Lester Young nicknamed her, was a highly original jazz and pop singer. In a career that spanned most of the 1930s, 1940s and 1950s, she displayed an uncanny ability to convey emotion through her voice. Her vocals, which were strongly inspired by instrumental jazz, are admired for their deeply personal and intimate sound. This compilation features recordings from the 1950s of Billie Holiday singing a string of her greatest successes. Enjoy this unique footage of one of jazz's all-time greats!

programme.title: Antibalas, Bettye LaVette, José James & Alice Russell
programme.desc: To close its 2019 edition, Jazz à la Villette pays tribute to the queen of soul Aretha Franklin, who died in the summer of 2018. The musical direction of the evening has been entrusted to Antibalas, an Afrobeat group from Brooklyn attached to the Daptones label, accompanied for the occasion by several guest singers: Bettye LaVette, José James, Alice Russell, Nona Hendryx & Zara McFarlane.

programme.title: Kazuki Yamada & Orchestre National du Capitole de Toulouse
programme.desc: 2024 marks the 100th anniversary of Gabriel Fauré's death. He is considered one of the most important and influential composers, having been the teacher of Maurice Ravel, Georges Enescu, Nadia Boulanger and many others. The Orchestre National du Capitole de Toulouse and The Philharmonic Chorus of Tokyo, with Florian Sempey as soloist, perform Gabriel Fauré's Requiem in the Basilique de Saint-Sernin in Toulouse, the largest surviving Romanesque church in France and one of the most important buildings in Romanesque architecture. This extraordinary concert is conducted by Kazuki Yamada, who is currently one of the most exciting young maestros. In spring 2023, he was appointed Principal Conductor and Artistic Advisor of the City of Birmingham Symphony Orchestra, and is also Artistic and Musical Director of the Orchestre Philharmonique de Monte-Carlo.

programme.title: Tim Weiss, Arctic Philharmonic, Berit Norbakken Solset & Øystein Moen
programme.sub-title: Glass - A Descent into the Maelström
programme.desc: ‘A Descent into the Maelström' (1841) is American writer Edgar Allan Poe's short story of two fishermen caught in torrents raging between the mountainous islands of Lofoten, inside the Arctic Circle of northern Norway. After a treacherous whirlpool drags their boat down, only one of them survives. American composer Philipp Glass based his choral work for the Australian Dance Theatre on this story. The piece was performed at the Adelaide Festival of Arts in 1986. Beacon Isle Films recorded an arrangement of Glass's work for symphony orchestra, performed by the Arctic Philharmonic Orchestra and Choir conducted by Tim Weiss. Soprano Berit Norbakken Solset is the soloist. The Artic Philharmonic Orchestra is the world's youngest and northernmost professional orchestral institution, presenting circa 150 performances and concerts each year. This 2019 recording was made against the backdrop of Lofoten's spectacular landscape: the very surroundings that inspired Poe's story.

programme.title: Eduard Topchjan & Armenian Philharmonic Orchestra
programme.desc: Conductor Eduard Topchjan leads the Armenian National Philharmonic Orchestra in a performance of Hector Berlioz's Symphonie fantastique, Op. 14. Berlioz wrote the piece of program music in 1830 while still a conservatory student. Inspired on the composer's unrequited love for Irish actress Harriet Smithson, the five-movement piece portrays the dreams of a young artist who has taken an overdose of opium in the aftermath of a failed love affair. Berlioz used one melody in each movement of the work representing the artist's beloved, an ‘idée fixe' (a fixed idea or obsession). The work is scored for a large orchestra and features an astonishing array of instrumental colors, including church bells, an off-stage oboe, and strings playing col legno (using the wood of their bow). This performance was recorded at the Aram Khachaturian Concert Hall in Yerevan, Armenia, in 2021.

programme.title: Benjamin Haemhouts, Casco Phil & Geert Baeckelandt
programme.sub-title: Mozart – Clarinet Concerto in A Major
programme.desc: Wolfgang Amadeus Mozart wrote his last completely instrumental piece in 1791. Clarinet Concerto in A Major was written for his friend Anton Stadler, who gave the first performance of it in Prague to a great reception according to the Berlin Musikalisches Wochenblatt. Today, a major part of the first movement is often used in auditions for orchestras and music schools. In this broadcast, the piece is performed by Casco Phil, a Belgian chamber orchestra led by Benjamin Haemhouts. Belgian clarinettist Geert Baeckelandt is the featured soloist.

Ягуарски хроники S1 E3 Присъединяваме се отново към екипа за драматични преживявания след дъждовния сезон, докато те търсят Фериня, Фера и Бадало, чиито нашийници за проследяване липсват.

Дълбините на Австралия S1 E2 Потопете се в хладните води край южния бряг, изправете се лице в лице с величествени сиви акули дойки, променящи формата си сепии и огромни сини китове и научете защо тези морета са пълни с живот.

Речни Чудовища S3 E4 Джереми се отправя към отдалечена река в австралийската пустош, за да се опита да хване рядка, но страховита сладководна риба трион. Хищникът достига до 5.5 м. дължина и атакува лодки.

Дивата Белгия S1 E3 Белгийските гори крият същества с необичайно поведение; мраволъвите яростно дърпат плячката си в пясъчни фунии да нахранят ларвите си, а росянките ловят непредпазливи насекоми с лепкавите си пипала.

Дълбините на Австралия S1 E3 Посещаваме дивите земи, където пустинята на Австралия се среща с горещия и враждебен Индийски океан, докато биоложката Лизи Дейли се гмурка с тигрови акули, манти и номадски костенурки.

Скритият вулкан: Изригване от ада На 15 януари 2022 г. вулканът Хунга Тонга - Хунга Хаапай изригна с мощност, равностойна на над 60 милиона тона тротил. Каква е причината за такова изключително мощно изригване на този вулкан?

Най-смъртоносните природни явления в света S2 E6 Студент описва урагана Мария от 2017 г., който опустошава Пуерто Рико. Градушка унищожава дом на семейство в Далас. Турист в дивата природа се опитва да спаси живота си при внезапно наводнение.

Речни Чудовища S3 E6 Джереми пътува до Япония, за да се опита да разкрие истината зад две от техните най-необикновени легенди за речни чудовища. Той е на път да открие чудовище, несравнимо с нищо, което е виждал досега.

Хищници Срещата на хищник с плячка е драматично събитие в природата: за единия е храна, за другия - въпрос на живот и смърт. Показваме какви стратегии използват най-големите хищници, за да уловят плячката си.

Екстремното речно предизвикателство на Стив Бакшал S1 E2 Стив и екипът му продължават пътуването си с каяк из долното дефиле на Балием; с извисяващите се над главите им назъбени скални стени и разбиващите се течения, рискът от преобръщане е постоянен.

Най-смъртоносните вулкани: светът в повишена степен на тревога Земята е дом на безброй активни вулкани, готови да изригнат всеки момент и да причинят масови разрушения. Вулканолози работят неуморно, за да опитат да предотвратят следващото катастрофално изригване.

Най-смъртоносните природни явления в света S2 E6 Студент описва урагана Мария от 2017 г., който опустошава Пуерто Рико. Градушка унищожава дом на семейство в Далас. Турист в дивата природа се опитва да спаси живота си при внезапно наводнение.
Гладиатори S1 E4 В далечния север на Америка има области с реки, блата и крайбрежия. Животните тук са най-добрите бойци, тъй като те са елитът на природата и калени в битки воини.

Ягуарски хроники S1 E4 Сред бури, наводнения и прекъсвания на електрозахранването Лизи и ветеринарният лекар Жоарес се мъчат да поставят нашийници на повече ягуари. Срещаме нова женска, която екипът е нетърпелив да проучи.

Дълбините на Австралия S1 E3 Посещаваме дивите земи, където пустинята на Австралия се среща с горещия и враждебен Индийски океан, докато биоложката Лизи Дейли се гмурка с тигрови акули, манти и номадски костенурки.

Най-смъртоносните природни явления в света S2 E5 Капската провинция в Южна Африка е поразена от силна буря и катастрофални горски пожари, които претоварват службите за спешна помощ.

Дивата Виена Виена е един от най-биологично активните градове в света; дивата природа процъфтява в нейните дворци, църкви и градини, а Донауинзел служи както за контрол на наводненията, така и за зона за отдих.

Екстремното речно предизвикателство на Стив Бакшал S1 E1 Стив Бакшал изследва река Балием на остров Нова Гвинея; той започва пътешествието си от езерото Хабема и се натъква на едни от най-екстремните бързеи, съществуващи на планетата.

Сан Андреас: надпревара с времето Разломът Сан Андреас е пресечна точка на две тектонични плочи, простиращи се през Сан Франциско и Лос Анджелис. Той е дълъг 1300 км и в момента е най-проучваният феномен в света.
Гладиатори S1 E1 Сухият сезон затяга хватката си върху малък водоем в голямата савана на Южна Африка; тук група гладиатори - големи и малки - са събрани в опасна близост.

programme.title: The Price Is Right
programme.desc: "Come on down!" "The Price Is Right" -- hosted by Bob Barker until 2007 and Drew Carey thereafter -- features a wide variety of games and contests with the same basic challenge: Guess the prices of everyday (or not-quite-everyday) retail items. Four contestants, all of whom are seated in one of the wildest audiences in daytime game-show history, are called to the stage to play a preliminary pricing round. That winner joins the host on stage for one of more than 70 different pricing games. After three such games, the contestants spin a big wheel -- hoping to get as close to $1 as possible -- in the "Showcase Showdown." The two highest winners of that round advance to the final, where prizes could be cars or roomsful of furniture. A trio of models presents the prizes.

programme.title: 六人行第7季:7
programme.desc: 菲比（莉莎·庫卓 Lisa Kudrow 飾）和瑞秋（詹妮弗·安妮斯頓 Jennifer Aniston 飾）的公寓已經修復完畢，菲比搬回了公寓，瑞秋繼續和喬伊（馬特·理勃蘭 Matt LeBlanc 飾）住在一起。喬伊在《Days of Our Lives》劇組裡得到了一個角色。就在錢德勒（馬修·派瑞 Matthew Perry 飾）和摩妮卡（柯特妮·考克斯 Courteney Cox 飾）的婚禮前一夜，錢德勒突然臨陣畏縮，逃走躲了起來。他走了之後，菲比在衛生間找了一支顯示有孕的驗孕棒，從而斷定摩妮卡有了身孕。菲比和羅斯（大衛·史威默 David Schwimmer 飾）在辦公室找到了躲藏錢德勒並說服他回來，回來後他聽到了菲比與瑞秋的竊竊私語——摩妮卡懷孕了！最後錢德勒和摩妮卡順利完婚，但摩妮卡卻說自己並沒有懷孕時。那麼，懷孕的人難道是瑞秋嗎？

programme.desc: 西蒙·貝克（Simon Baker）飾演派屈克·簡（Patrick Jane），一名受僱於加州調查局（California Bureau of Investigation，CBI）之獨立顧問。他利用出色的觀察技巧（如讀心術），成功偵破多宗大案。他過去經常使用所謂的心靈感應，曾假裝擁有通靈能力的靈媒而成名。派屈克·簡在一電視節目透露使用心靈感應協助警方調查連環殺手「紅約翰」（Red John），他的妻女因而被其殺害。在自責之下，他放棄作為騙人的靈媒，成為警方顧問。

programme.title: 卡那洛效應第4季:16
programme.desc: 麥可卡那洛是一個職業魔術師，卻是個愛開玩笑的人，他在一些很平常的場合裡，對一些猜想不到的人表演難解的魔術，全都被隱藏式攝影機拍下。

programme.title: 生活冷知識第3季:3
programme.desc: 歡迎來到由 Kevin Pereira 和 Brooke Van Poppelen 主持的每週節目，該節目以喜劇形式講述了永無止境的日常生活小貼士。 從學習如何用鞋子打開一瓶酒，到找出衛生紙捲的多種用途，永遠不乏有待發現的訣竅。 觀眾請注意：你們的生活將永遠不一樣。

programme.title: 好友互整第6季:13
programme.desc: 節目的四位主角是從小一起長大的死黨，他們的任務是輪番被整，他們從小就愛拿最令人難堪、不舒服的挑戰來嗆對方。

programme.title: 馬克羅伯的復仇製造所第1季:1
programme.desc: 這個全新系列堪稱宅宅的逆襲，前NASA工程師和現任蘋果工程師，在網路上的亮片惡作劇影片有5200萬觀看次數，證明書呆子也能闖出一片天。加入馬克羅伯的專家團隊，懲罰那些沒有道德的人。設置陷阱、放誘餌，然後等待壞人上鉤。

programme.title: 馬克羅伯的復仇製造所第1季:2
programme.desc: 這個全新系列堪稱宅宅的逆襲，前NASA工程師和現任蘋果工程師，在網路上的亮片惡作劇影片有5200萬觀看次數，證明書呆子也能闖出一片天。加入馬克羅伯的專家團隊，懲罰那些沒有道德的人。設置陷阱、放誘餌，然後等待壞人上鉤。

programme.title: 宅男行不行第8季:5
programme.desc: 在上一季的結尾，萊納德和佩妮宣佈訂婚，他們和謝爾頓商量讓他搬出公寓，女友艾米建議謝爾頓與她同居，這把謝爾頓嚇壞了。與此同時，他們最愛的漫畫店慘遭火災。謝爾頓一時間難以接受生活中的種種變故，負氣出走。一個多月過去了，謝爾頓會在這場跨越美國大陸的旅程中遭遇什麼？在新的一季中，其他幾位主角的生活也有新變化。佩妮放棄了演藝事業，正式踏入了藥品推銷之路，她與伯納黛特將會成為同事。霍華德最煩惱的事是，自己的媽媽和漫畫店老闆斯圖爾特住在一起。單身漢拉傑什何時才能找到女朋友？

programme.title: 六人行第7季:8
programme.desc: 菲比（莉莎·庫卓 Lisa Kudrow 飾）和瑞秋（詹妮弗·安妮斯頓 Jennifer Aniston 飾）的公寓已經修復完畢，菲比搬回了公寓，瑞秋繼續和喬伊（馬特·理勃蘭 Matt LeBlanc 飾）住在一起。喬伊在《Days of Our Lives》劇組裡得到了一個角色。就在錢德勒（馬修·派瑞 Matthew Perry 飾）和摩妮卡（柯特妮·考克斯 Courteney Cox 飾）的婚禮前一夜，錢德勒突然臨陣畏縮，逃走躲了起來。他走了之後，菲比在衛生間找了一支顯示有孕的驗孕棒，從而斷定摩妮卡有了身孕。菲比和羅斯（大衛·史威默 David Schwimmer 飾）在辦公室找到了躲藏錢德勒並說服他回來，回來後他聽到了菲比與瑞秋的竊竊私語——摩妮卡懷孕了！最後錢德勒和摩妮卡順利完婚，但摩妮卡卻說自己並沒有懷孕時。那麼，懷孕的人難道是瑞秋嗎？

programme.desc: 在上一季的結尾，萊納德和佩妮宣佈訂婚，他們和謝爾頓商量讓他搬出公寓，女友艾米建議謝爾頓與她同居，這把謝爾頓嚇壞了。與此同時，他們最愛的漫畫店慘遭火災。謝爾頓一時間難以接受生活中的種種變故，負氣出走。一個多月過去了，謝爾頓會在這場跨越美國大陸的旅程中遭遇什麼？在新的一季中，其他幾位主角的生活也有新變化。佩妮放棄了演藝事業，正式踏入了藥品推銷之路，她與伯納黛特將會成為同事。霍華德最煩惱的事是，自己的媽媽和漫畫店老闆斯圖爾特住在一起。單身漢拉傑什何時才能找到女朋友？

programme.desc: 菲比（莉莎·庫卓 Lisa Kudrow 飾）和瑞秋（詹妮弗·安妮斯頓 Jennifer Aniston 飾）的公寓已經修復完畢，菲比搬回了公寓，瑞秋繼續和喬伊（馬特·理勃蘭 Matt LeBlanc 飾）住在一起。喬伊在《Days of Our Lives》劇組裡得到了一個角色。就在錢德勒（馬修·派瑞 Matthew Perry 飾）和摩妮卡（柯特妮·考克斯 Courteney Cox 飾）的婚禮前一夜，錢德勒突然臨陣畏縮，逃走躲了起來。他走了之後，菲比在衛生間找了一支顯示有孕的驗孕棒，從而斷定摩妮卡有了身孕。菲比和羅斯（大衛·史威默 David Schwimmer 飾）在辦公室找到了躲藏錢德勒並說服他回來，回來後他聽到了菲比與瑞秋的竊竊私語——摩妮卡懷孕了！最後錢德勒和摩妮卡順利完婚，但摩妮卡卻說自己並沒有懷孕時。那麼，懷孕的人難道是瑞秋嗎？

programme.title: Schau dich schlau: Die Zeit läuft
programme.desc: Heute bei Schau dich schlau: Zeit ist zwar eine physikalische Größe, die sich durch Uhren bis auf Millisekunden messen lässt. programme.title: Invasion of the Body Snatchers
programme.desc: This remake of the classic horror film is set in San Francisco. Matthew Bennell assumes that when a friend complains of her husband's strange mood, it's a marital issue. However, he begins to worry as more people report similar observations. His concern is confirmed when writer Jack Bellicec and his wife discover a mutated corpse. Besieged by an invisible enemy, Bennell must work quickly before the city is consumed.

programme.title: Frankenstein
programme.desc: In this re-imagining of Mary Shelley's classic, Dr. Frankenstein is Dr. Victor Helios (Thomas Kretschmann), who has found the means to prolong his life into the present. Portrayed as the villain, Helios has amassed a collection of monsters that are killing people in New Orleans. Detectives Carson O'Connor (Parker Posey) and Michael Sloane (Adam Goldberg) team with the doctor's first creation, Deucalion (Vincent Perez), to track down and stop the crazed evil scientist.

programme.title: Georgia Rule
programme.desc: Teenage Rachel (Lindsay Lohan) is a real thorn in the side of her mother, Lilly (Felicity Huffman). More than just rebellious, she is incorrigible. After Rachel crashes a car, Lilly decides to haul the girl off to a place to which she vowed never to return: Her own mother's (Jane Fonda) Idaho home. Georgia, the family matriarch, lives by a strict code and expects all under her roof to do the same. Given structure and purpose, Rachel's anger at the world begins to subside.
